newsitems.title: Helldivers 2 получила новых мутировавших терминидов и подземные логова
newsitems.contents:
PlayStation и Arrowhead Game Studios представили новые угрозы для кооперативного шутера Helldivers 2. В игру проник новый вид терминидов под названием Noxious, отличающийся ядовитыми атаками и повышенной агрессивностью. Вместе с ним на планетах галактики появилось больше подземных пещер и разветвлённых туннелей, где противники могут нападать из засады.

Среди новых врагов — быстрый Noxious Scavenger и массивный Noxious Spewer. Первый атакует ядовитыми укусами, а второй способен опутывать бойцов паутиной, лишая их возможности бежать. Яд постепенно отнимает здоровье и ухудшает обзор, поэтому отрядам придётся следить за состоянием товарищей и беречь стимуляторы. Для борьбы с заражением разработчики рекомендуют дробовики, огнемёты и гранаты.

Подземные логова теперь могут появляться в самых разных биомах — от выжженных пустынь до заснеженных тундр. В тесных туннелях ограничена видимость, поэтому бойцам придётся действовать сообща и использовать оружие для ближнего боя.

Helldivers 2 доступна на PlayStation 5, ПК и Xbox Series X|S.

newsitems.title: Helldivers 2: new poisonous Terminid types, bug caves spawn across the galaxy

[p]Attention, Helldivers. 
 
The Ministry of Truth confirms that a new Terminid strain is skittering across the front lines. Terminid cave networks now course beneath more biomes in the galaxy from scorched deserts to frozen tundras. Every planet may have a hive beneath it.[/p][p][/p][p]Here is everything a Helldiver needs to know courtesy of the Ministry of Truth: [/p][previewyoutube="4AjAyMGQSlw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Noxious Scavenger: small, fast, and full of venom[/b] [/h3][p]At first glance these resemble ordinary Scavengers. Their additional vileness becomes more apparent when they skitter in to attack. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/538d5777376251929fa86af6003521c343ea17d2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Noxious Scavengers are noticeably quicker than their cousins which makes them hard to keep in your sights. Every bite delivers a deadly dose of poison and they are ready to bite again almost immediately. Fortunately, they are fragile. Weapons that reward volume over precision such as shotguns, flamethrowers, and grenades, will make short work of them. Super Earth reminds you that ammunition is cheaper than antivenom. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/e0118d6711a0e55e2df2c34b3950bfe521fd4461.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Noxious Spewer: the big one[/b] [/h3][p]Forget everything you know about Spewers dragging themselves across the ground. One hit and you lose the ability to sprint, which is exactly what the abomination wants: to slow its prey and close the gap. Beware its bite, which is quick, has surprising reach, and carries a stronger dose of venom than anything a Scavenger can deliver. [/p][p]While its head is protected by medium armor, its web-filled abdomen has no armor at all. Be cautious when targeting this location, as when the sac bursts in a [b]Web Explosion[/b], it will snare every Helldiver and bug nearby. You can track your condition with the new poison icon on your HUD. Super Earth categorizes the poisoning as follows:  [/p][p][b]Lightly poisoned:[/b] Your vision starts to haze, the poison begins to eat away at your health 
[b]Heavily poisoned: [/b]Damage over time increases, you lose the ability to sprint, your vision hazes, Lady Liberty comes to visit you 
 [/p][p]Thankfully, your stims will help cure your condition, so ration them wisely. A poisoned squadmate may need that stim to keep going and fulfill your mission [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/d8317b92448b25ab10a354cef32e3d9c47cb3d64.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Caves on more biomes[/b] [/h3][p]The Terminids have gone underground and Super Earth is hunting them down. Bug caves are no longer limited to a handful of worlds; they now have a chance to appear across more biomes on the Galactic map. [/p][p]Inside these tunnels sightlines are short, corners are blind, and fast enemies arrive before you hear them. Absolutely ideal territory for those Noxious bugs. Bring close-range firepower, stay with your squad, and keep a stim in reserve for whoever wandered too far ahead. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/51db9ba462a574ada09bf685eb0631bad0ec2bb9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Suit up, Helldiver[/b] [/h3][p]The Noxious strain want the galaxy wrapped in silk and soaked in venom. newsitems.title: Helldivers 2 появилась на торрентах - игру запустили через автономную сборку HellForge + Goldberg
newsitems.contents:
В сети появилась неофициальная автономная сборка Helldivers 2, созданная на базе проекта HellForge и Goldberg Steam Emulator. В отличие от обычной установки HellForge, которая проверяет наличие купленной игры в библиотеке Steam, новая Portable-версия позволяет запускать игру в офлайн-режиме без стандартной проверки владения через Steam.

В основе сборки лежит Helldivers 2 Build 25480438. Именно эту версию разработчики HellForge выбрали в качестве постоянной базы проекта. HellForge запускает отдельную копию игры с локальным серверным бэкендом вместо официальной инфраструктуры Arrowhead и позволяет использовать модификации, новые виды оружия, стратагемы, изменённые характеристики и дополнительные уровни сложности.

При этом речь не идёт о полноценной замене актуальной версии Helldivers 2. HellForge намеренно закреплён за Build 25480438 и развивается как отдельная модифицируемая экосистема со своим локальным бэкендом. Официальная Galactic War, актуальные обновления Arrowhead и инфраструктура основной версии игры к ней не относятся.

Сам HellForge в последние недели заметно расширил возможности. В версии 0.3.0 разработчики добавили публичный матчмейкинг и синхронизацию модов. Теперь пользователям проекта необязательно заранее искать партнёров через Discord или играть только с друзьями — подходящие сессии могут отображаться публично, а клиент способен определить используемые хозяином матча модификации.

В результате вокруг Helldivers 2 постепенно формируется отдельная неофициальная среда, существующая параллельно основной версии игры. Появление готовой Portable-сборки с Goldberg стало следующим этапом этого процесса: теперь сторонние разработчики объединили локальную инфраструктуру HellForge с альтернативной реализацией функций Steam.

newsitems.title: Helldivers 2 boss can "absolutely see" making a game parody of generative AI, but it would need to be "quirky" rather than "doom-laden"
newsitems.contents:
Arrowhead's chief creative officer Johan Pilestedt can well imagine the Helldivers studio developing a videogame that satirises or parodies today's generative AI technology. The game in question wouldn't be a Helldivers project, however, and Pilestedt says it would need to be relatively upbeat, rather than an exercise in feverish despair. This seems like a tall order right now, at least while Tim Sweeney still has access to Twitter.

newsitems.title: Helldivers 2 на ПК подверглась ревью-бомбингу из-за Easy Anti-Cheat, которая сломала значительную часть модов
newsitems.contents:
Несмотря на то, что с момента выхода 8 февраля 2024 года игра Helldivers 2 была очень тепло встречена пользователями, сейчас она столкнулась с волной негативных отзывов на ПК. Причиной стало нововведение от студии Arrowhead Game Studios, вызвавшее у игроков сильное недовольство.

В этот PvE-шутер от третьего лица была внедрена античит-система Easy Anti-Cheat. Разработчики сочли этот шаг необходимым, чтобы заблокировать модификации, предоставляющие игрокам несправедливые преимущества. К сожалению, появление этого программного обеспечения не обошлось без побочных эффектов.

В результате перестали работать многие модификации — в том числе те, что исправляли ошибки, добавляли новый контент или расширяли функционал игры. В ответ на это игроки начали оставлять в Steam преимущественно отрицательные отзывы, выражая своё недовольство студии Arrowhead. Сейчас рейтинг игры составляет 39% на основе более 9 тыс. недавних обзоров.

newsitems.title: Arrowhead не планирует Helldivers 3: "Сиквел имеет смысл только если будет кардинально другим"
newsitems.contents:
Йохан Пилестедт подтвердил, что планов на создание третьей части Helldivers по-прежнему нет. «95% студии сосредоточено на Helldivers 2, а небольшая команда сейчас занимается прототипированием следующей игры Arrowhead», — отметил он. В штате студии около 150 человек.

Пилестедт подчеркнул, что Arrowhead хочет «расти на своих собственных условиях и знать, когда остановиться», отметив, что многие команды добиваются больших успехов и сразу же удваивают свой размер.

Ключевое опасение — разделить аудиторию, пока у Helldivers 2 ещё есть поклонники.

«На данный момент я считаю, что сиквел всё обнуляет и заставляет игроков начинать заново. Продолжение превращает игру в хобби на всю жизнь, как LEGO или Warhammer».

Пилестедт охарактеризовал Helldivers 2 как «третье пространство» — сообщество, где люди могут проводить огромное количество времени, но при этом уезжать на месяцы или годы и всё равно находить удовольствие и общение при возвращении. Для сравнения, на момент публикации количество активных игроков Helldivers 2 в Steam составляло 47 097 человек — не рекорд, но приличный показатель для игры двухлетней давности (без учёта консолей).

«Некоторые студии могут относиться к игрокам как к источнику краткосрочной прибыли. Мы же видим в игроках настоящий двигатель игры: именно они привлекают друзей, создают мемы и поддерживают игру в живом состоянии. Когда у вас есть активное сообщество, которое этим занимается, вам не нужен сиквел».

Пилестедт также заявил, что «индустрия в панике, потому что старые приёмы с онлайн-сервисами больше не работают». Он не уточнил, что именно имел в виду, но, вероятно, речь о недавних отменах игр с онлайн-сервисами.

«Главным конкурентом Helldivers 3 будет Helldivers 2. Создание отдельного сиквела имеет смысл только в том случае, если он настолько отличается, что обе игры могут существовать параллельно. На данный момент улучшать Helldivers 2 с каждым днём гораздо разумнее, чем терять её потенциал».

Остаётся открытым вопрос, насколько сильно Helldivers 3 должна отличаться от предшественницы. Helldivers 2 сама по себе была радикальным шагом вперёд по сравнению с оригиналом: вид сверху сменился стрельбой от третьего лица с упором на физику и реалистичное управление оружием. Куда Arrowhead может двигаться дальше — пока неясно. Но, судя по словам Пилестедта, студия не спешит с сиквелом, пока Helldivers 2 остаётся живым проектом с активным сообществом.

newsitems.title: В Helldivers 2 меняют античит: GameGuard уступает место Easy Anti-Cheat
newsitems.contents:
Helldivers 2 меняет античит-систему. Разработчики из Arrowhead хотят усилить безопасность. Они планируют жестко бороться с читерскими модами. Такие модификации портят совместную игру и мешают другим геймерам.

«Интеграция GameGuard в Helldivers 2 оказалась не такой эффективной, как хотелось бы», — заявили авторы шутера, объявляя о переходе на Easy Anti-Cheat. «В итоге мы решили выбрать другой путь и довериться EAC. Это признанный индустриальный стандарт, который используют более 200 игр. Мы верим, что это надежно защитит "Галактическую войну", обеспечит честную игру и сохранит целостность геймплея».

Система Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC) от Epic Games хорошо знакома игрокам. Она используется в таких хитах, как Elden Ring, Fortnite, Rust и недавно вышедшей Gears of War: E-Day. В Arrowhead отметили, что вместе с внедрением EAC добавят «дополнительные инструменты безопасности», чтобы усилить защиту и лучше сохранить целостность игры.

В рамках этой борьбы под раздачу могут попасть и безобидные моды на замену скинов. Если игроки посчитают, что новый античит по ошибке заблокировал безопасный мод или другую программу, Arrowhead просит писать в их техподдержку через Zendesk.

Конечно, создавать проблемы моддерам всегда неприятно. Но в игре, которая держится на мультиплеере, такие жесткие меры вполне оправданы. Одно дело — творить что угодно в одиночной "песочнице", где играешь сам или с друзьями. Совсем другое — мешать незнакомцам в онлайне. Одно дело прийти на бой в костюме Кадзумы Кирю или Джокера Хита Леджера, но портить игру другим — это уже перебор. Судя по сайту Nexus Mods, главным полем битвы для модификаций Helldivers 2 могут стать улучшения интерфейса и HUD. Они видны только самому игроку, но некоторые из них могут давать нечестное преимущество. Смена античита запланирована уже на сегодня, 20 октября.

newsitems.title: Changing anti-cheat in HELLDIVERS 2
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]Greetings Helldivers,[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we want to talk about an upcoming change to our anti-cheat, answer some questions we have seen arise in the community around modding, and discuss how it may impact you as a player. [/p][p][/p][p]Fairness and honor have always been strong foundations for Helldivers in our fight in the Galactic War. But we have seen for too long that there are some who would bend the rules and definitions of fairness, affecting not only their own games but also the battles of those who play alongside them, affecting pick-up rates, and even going so far as to manipulate the war itself, breaking the unfolding story and dragging down innocent players with it. [/p][p][/p][p]We haven't previously commented on modding, other than to warn that from a technical perspective, we can’t guarantee their safety or usability for players. However, we feel that this change, considering what it affects, is giving us an opportunity to do so.[/p][p][/p][p]We know mods are part of the DNA of PC gaming and gaming communities as a whole. In general, we appreciate the creativity behind cosmetic and non-gameplay mods, which players can enjoy without negatively impacting those who play alongside them. Where we need to improve is how we protect players against modifications that create unfair advantages or negatively impact others, which goes beyond software manipulation to tamper with our game. [/p][p][/p][p]As a stepping stone on this journey, we are doing two things:[/p][olist][*][p]Implementing additional security measures to crack down on recent cheat mods that have been circulating.[/p][/*][*][p]Transitioning from GameGuard to Easy Anti-Cheat today, October 20th, with additional security tools in place to enhance its effectiveness and improve game integrity protection.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]These changes mean that some mods, particularly the types that are affecting the experience of other players, may no longer function. It also means that some non-malicious cosmetic mods may require updates from their individual creators in order to keep working.[/p][p][/p][p]We believe these are steps in the right direction, and we want to remain transparent about our decisions and intentions as we continue to improve the integrity and security of the game, to give players a consistent and fair experience, and to strengthen trust with our dedicated community.
[/p][p]As always, we appreciate your continued feedback and support, Helldivers. See you on the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2][p][b]Q. Why are you changing from GameGuard to Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC)?[/b][/p][p]A. The implementation of GameGuard for HELLDIVERS 2 wasn't as effective as it could have been, and in the end we decided to take another path with EAC. [/p][p][/p][p]EAC is an industry standard used in over 200 games, and we believe this will be an effective way to protect the Galactic War and will better protect fair gameplay and the integrity of the game. [/p][p][/p][p]For more information about EAC, please visit their [u][url="https://www.easy.ac/support/articles"]official support[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. My cosmetic mod stopped working–what do I do?[/b][/p][p]A. Occasionally, mods will no longer function after an update and modders may need to update their projects to ensure they continue working with our updates and patches.

If you feel EAC or another system is blocking a non-destructive mod or other software, we encourage you to reach out to our [u][url="https://arrowhead.zendesk.com/"]official support on Zendesk[/url][/u] to let us know.
[/p][p][b]Q. How can I tell which mods are safe to use?[/b][/p][p]A. Using mods is done at your own discretion, and so we cannot determine what’s safe vs. unsafe to use.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Does the implementation of EAC in HELLDIVERS 2 impose any new hardware requirements?[/b][/p][p]A. No, there are no changes in hardware requirements. 

For the minimum required specifications for HELLDIVERS 2, please see [u][url="https://arrowhead.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/12517838794268-Minimum-requirements"]our article on Zendesk[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. I play HELLDIVERS 2 on Steam Deck / Linux. Will I still be able to play?[/b][/p][p]A. Yes, you can still play. Steam Deck and Linux compatibility remains unchanged.[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Helldivers 2 получит снайперское военное звание с новым оружием и камуфляжной бронёй
newsitems.contents:
Arrowhead Game Studios анонсировала новое премиальное военное звание «Авторитетное око» для Helldivers 2. Набор выйдет 20 октября и ориентирован прежде всего на игроков, предпочитающих уничтожать противников на больших дистанциях. В него войдут четыре вида оружия, граната, специальная броня и косметические предметы.

Главной новинкой станет снайперская винтовка R-40 «Соколиный глаз» с бронебойными патронами, рассчитанная на точную стрельбу издалека. Для ближнего боя предусмотрен компактный пистолет-пулемёт P-44 «Фоскья», а против тяжёлобронированных целей пригодится антиматериальная винтовка AMW-20 Apex с автоматической перезарядкой и питанием от специального рюкзака.

Арсенал дополнит энергетическая винтовка LAS-44 Nova, способная выпускать высокоточный тепловой снаряд после короткого цикла перезарядки. Также игроки получат гранату G-11 Triboli, которая разбрасывает взрывные суббоеприпасы, помогая замедлять и оглушать противников.

Особое внимание разработчики уделили экипировке. Броня SS-33 «Шериф» выполнена в стиле камуфляжных костюмов для скрытного передвижения и оснащена пассивной способностью «Статический плащ». Она уменьшает отдачу оружия и радиус обнаружения персонажа, когда тот сидит или лежит.

В комплект также войдут тематические плащи, эмоция «Ручная баллистическая проекция» и титул «Отборный снайпер». Судя по составу набора, «Авторитетное око» должно расширить возможности игроков, предпочитающих точечные атаки и контроль дистанции, хотя эффективность нового оружия станет понятна только после выхода обновления.

[p]Picture this: A chilly autumn breeze ripples through the forest as a battalion of Automatons amble towards an outpost. They move together like cogs in a larger wheel, chanting in their electric tongues as they march, when a peal of thunder breaks their mechanical trance.[/p][p][/p][p]But it’s not thunder. It’s you, Helldiver– Liberty’s sharpest shooter taking aim from inside the tree line, busting them down to bolts and puddles of bubbling oil.
[/p][p]On October 20, the Ministry of Defense will authorize deployment of the [i]Scope of Authority Premium Warbond* [/i]- the next leap forward in long-range and clandestine combat solutions to guarantee your squad never misses the mark.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Weapons & Stratagems[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/75d2a4c793243121342782ee538bc90c11a212a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The best sniper knows the balance of stability and power is a delicate one, and a primary sniper rifle that can balance both is a tall order. After extensive research and trials in the Ministry of Defense, they have developed an elegant solution: The [b]R-40 Sightliner[/b] bolt-action sniper rifle. Your trusty sidekick with the eagle eyes, the Sightliner can provide powerful armor piercing rounds [i]and [/i]long-range precision.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/e70d998881fd4437a3c76ab445301a850189111d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The perfect companion to the exactitude of a sniper rifle primary is something that can provide that same steadfastness with the speed and versatility of a pistol. That brings us to the purpose-built [b]P-44 Mist[/b], a one-handed machine pistol designed for a compact carry. If the enemy closes in on you, carve a path out with the help of the P-44![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/0570b110a8cd279fc7a8e6348295ec19d53ed26d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As we have faced larger and more heavily-armored foes, we have responded by making a more powerful and armor-penetrating, backpack-fed, colossal anti-materiel rifle featuring assisted reload: the [b]AMW-20 Apex[/b]. The Apex is far from subtle, but there is not much in the galaxy that could survive an assault from it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/b92359f4aff5bbd88c9a117ca25e7fb13858ee94.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For the advanced tech-loving teams, there is a new entry to the LAS series of energy weapons: the [b]LAS-44 Nova[/b]! This sleek rifle has the luxury of infinite ammo provided by weapons of its type, but it fires a high-precision non-explosive thermal projectile after a short charge cycle. A new optimization routine designed specifically for better cooldown performance means your rifle will be firing longer after all targets have been eliminated.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/ccbd998cbad915d7221725527e1b1860d157fbfe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When thrown, the [b]G-11 Caltrops[/b] scatters a wide field of proximity-detonated submunitions that slow and stun foes, making them easier to get in your sights.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Armors, passive, and more[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/335df02c3e14258f79a9beccb1f3fb68f4387bc1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Long distance shooters know better than anyone how much time you spend in the cover of nature to get your shot. That’s why the [b]SS-33 Mimetic Marshal[/b] [b]light armor[/b] is inspired by old-fashioned ghillie suits without sacrificing on modern tactical polish. Utilizing state-of-the-art light-diffusing netting and adaptive fiber technology, the Mimetic Marshall, and the coordinating Mimetic Mesh cape and player card, will let you blend into your surroundings while keeping you light enough on your feet to move in on your mark.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/216a2ab47f8e243df63d2bc66906e7c6fe0a5a41.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If your tactical approach mixes in more forward marching than camping in the bushes, the [b]SS-15 Focal Point medium armor[/b] can round out the edges of your loadout with integrated adaptive camouflage and cutting-edge optics in a stylish asymmetrical visor. The Focal Point armor looks best paired with the Boundary Banner cape and player card.[/p][p][/p][p]No matter which one you choose for the job, both armors are equipped with the Stationary Shroud passive, which reduces weapon sway and detection range by mimicking foliage concealment while in the crouched or prone position. Crouch down and watch as your Helldiver disappears into the wilderness around you: the perfect cover.[/p][p][/p][p]Along with the impressive stratagems, weapons, and armors, you’ll also get the Manual Ballistic Projection emote and a new title to claim to demonstrate your prowess as a distance shooter: [i]Longshot[/i]. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/491a767f6fb1790072569084ce338cfd4da8f00f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Helldivers, your scope of authority has just been widened – time to set your sights on enemies of Managed Democracy once and for all. The Scope of Authority Premium Warbond launches [b]October 20[/b]![/p][p]

[/p][p][i]*Requires base game, Super Credits and game progression to unlock.[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: Алан Ритчсон заменит Джейсона Момоа в фильме Helldivers - премьеру перенесли на 2028 год
newsitems.contents:
Sony нашла нового исполнителя главной роли в экранизации Helldivers. После ухода Джейсона Момоа проект возглавит Алан Ритчсон. Одновременно студия объявила о переносе фильма почти на семь месяцев.

Премьера Helldivers теперь запланирована на 9 июня 2028 года. Изначально картину собирались выпустить 10 ноября 2027-го.

Режиссёром по-прежнему остаётся Джастин Лин. Джейсон Момоа должен был сыграть главную роль, однако летом покинул проект, после чего Sony начала искать ему замену. Теперь эту позицию занял Алан Ритчсон.

Подробности сюжета и персонажа Ритчсона пока не раскрываются. Неизвестно и то, насколько близко фильм будет следовать событиям игр или какие элементы Helldivers и Helldivers 2 станут основой сценария.

Перенос премьеры произошёл на фоне активного развития экранизаций игровых франшиз. Sony рассчитывает выпустить Helldivers уже после ряда других крупных проектов по мотивам видеоигр, а новый актёр должен стать главным лицом фильма.

newsitems.title: Launching Devoid of Liberty: A Look Back
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p][i]From the desk of our Creative Director, Mikael Eriksson[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Helldivers,[/p][p]The Void has been pierced and the Illuminate's latest shenanigans have been decisively dealt with! Well done! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/90ba75683138f9739b746faceae7602ddf6fb460.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The[b] Devoid of Liberty [/b]launch has run its course and history has been written. Before we dive into whatever comes next, I wanted to take a moment and talk about how I personally think this update landed. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]What We Were Going For[/b][/h3][p][b]I consider Devoid of Liberty to be a ‘vertical slice’ of what we want this game to be every week. [/b]Not in terms of new content (we can’t keep up with that), but in terms of fantasy cohesion. The Void’s presence transcended the game: it was felt outside of the SE Destroyer windows and the Galactic War map. It was in what you read in the mission descriptions, what you saw on the battlefield, what you heard in the war reporting, and what you created as a community. The throughline was strong across the game and the community. [/p][p][/p][p]This is the future that we’re aiming for: a future where the Galactic War is this interesting and dynamic every day, and felt inside and out of the game. [/p][p][/p][p][b]With the Void specifically, we wanted to dive deeper on Illuminate lore.[/b] We had already explored the Terminid Hive Worlds and the Automaton Cyborg Factories, so it felt like the logical next step to expand our universe. The Illuminate are all about mystery, exploring the unknown, and being confronted with technology and intentions you can't fully understand. With [i]Heart of Democracy[/i], we had already told the classic invasion story of "[i]Aliens attacking innocent civilians![/i]" This time we wanted to explore more about who they really are and how they work.

We wanted the Void to feel like stepping into an oppressive, alien environment that actively resented your presence. From the haunting environmental audio design to the unsettling visual distortion of the Void flora, every element was built to keep Helldivers on edge.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The new enemy variants earned their teeth.[/b] The twisted, razor-limbed human experiments proved once again the Illuminate’s blatant disregard for the sanctity of human life, something Super Earth could [i]never[/i] relate to. We also expanded on the Illuminate Fleet system, and grouped all Illuminate enemies into different Fleets, which gives flavour but also adds to the believability and gives you more to consider when choosing loadouts. Going forward, this sort of thing is what we’re considering for all factions. We don’t want a one size fits all loadout for any Faction, you should always need to consider what you’re about to engage with. [/p][p][/p][p][b]SEAF squadmates are the thing I'm most hyped about in this update.[/b] Fighting with a squad that follows commands, reacts to the fight [i](and occasionally hugs you mid-firefight, for reasons)[/i] is something Niklas Malmborg and I have talked about doing for a long time. It’s a war, after all! As we continue to expand the game, we want to both explore tighter, less crowded spaces as well as bigger, more chaotic battlefields, and this was a crucial step in that direction for us. We also wanted to give solo players and understaffed squads a genuine lifeline without breaking the four-Helldiver core experience.[strike]
[/strike][b]
The Warhammer 40,000 ‘Castellan's Creed’ Warbond brought new blood in without diluting the tone.[/b] As always, we chose our partners with great care. If done wrong, a crossover could feel like it's wearing Super Earth's uniform without buying into Managed Democracy, and that is something we won’t do. I think we threaded that needle and ended up with a Warbond that's genuinely great while staying true to the original IP, and I was very happy to see positive reactions from the Warhammer fans. You guys are known to be particular about details![/p][p][/p][h3][b]What We’re Still Working On[/b][/h3][p][b]Launch stability was too patchy (pun intended).[/b] We had nasty crashes on fullscreen terminal interaction and issues for players using ultra-wide monitors. An update of this size needed a cleaner landing, and it took us two follow-up patches to get there.[/p][p][/p][p][b]These big beats should run for longer, and the endings should be more clearly shaped by the community.[/b] The two things we've heard most since the Devoid of Liberty launch: you wanted more time in the Void, and you wanted the community choices to shape the ending in impactful ways. Both of these are impacted by how we structured the campaigns: how many phases a Campaign runs, how long content stays live, and how much room our Game Masters have to react to the community in interesting ways. That's the part we're working on iterating on for the next big update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Some quality-of-life asks are still sitting in the backlog.[/b] Assist-reloading and backpack icon clarity were great wins, but there's still a long list of smaller frictions behind them, and they're on the board.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Where We Go From Here[/b][/h3][p]I'm happy with this update, and it was as fun as always to follow the developments live, but I know there's still room to improve. The Void isn't finished with us, and neither are we with it. Stability will stay the priority between updates, and the campaign structure work above is the one to watch for going forwards. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your devotion to diving and dying and diving again. Stay frosty, Helldivers.[/p][p][i]For Super Earth. For Liberty.[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: Вышел новый трейлер Helldivers 2, демонстрирующий танк TD-110 Maelstrom
newsitems.contents:
Студия Arrowhead Game Studios выпустила новый трейлер Helldivers 2, представив новую боевую машину для этого кооперативного шутера — танк TD-110 Maelstrom. Ролик оформлен как рекламный материал внутриигровой компании X-UDE; закадровый голос рассказывает о характеристиках и преимуществах новинки.

У нас в X-UDE лишь одна мечта: высокая прибыль и возможность личной защиты для каждого. Ведь любой гражданин Супер-Земли имеет право защитить свою семью, не жертвуя при этом комфортом, который дарует Управляемая демократия. Именно поэтому мы сотрудничаем с Адскими десантниками (Helldivers), чтобы получить ресурсы, необходимые для воплощения этой мечты в жизнь. Вместе мы сможем обеспечить личную защиту в каждом доме. X-UDE. Танк у каждого порога. Роскошь в каждой детали.

Появление танка TD-110 Maelstrom в Helldivers 2 — часть крупного обновления, включающего ряд изменений, основанных на отзывах сообщества. Среди них: враги больше не будут атаковать пустую технику; улучшен учёт статистики убийств с помощью мин, техники, дронов и рюкзаков; а также исправлены ошибки, возникавшие на арктических планетах.

Обновление также скорректировало систему появления врагов, чтобы сделать распределение противников более сбалансированным для разделившихся во время миссии десантников; внесены изменения в миссии по эвакуации ценных активов и скорректирован баланс множества видов оружия. Изменения коснулись и дизайна уровней: теперь места появления добычи и оружия стали более случайными, добавлены новые наборы предметов (боеприпасы, аптечки, гранаты, оружие), а также увеличено на 10 количество обычных образцов, которые можно собрать на уровне.

Helldivers 2 доступна на ПК, PS5 и Xbox Series X/S.

newsitems.title: Devoid of Liberty: 7.1.0
newsitems.author: PS_7
newsitems.contents:
[b]*** INCOMING TRANSMISSION FROM SUPER EARTH HIGH COMMAND ***[/b]

[b][h3]🤝 Community Feedback Changes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*]Enemies will no longer target unoccupied vehicles
[*]The career stats now correctly tracks kills from mines, vehicles, drones and backpacks
[*]Players can no longer get stuck in a state where they are unable to be reinforced even after another player throws a reinforcement stratagem or the whole squad dies. This was rare but could happen under poor network conditions
[*]Fixed issue that caused Ice Plant hazard, found on arctic planets, to ragdoll and stagger more than intended.
[*]Stratagem Hero - Destroyer based leaderboards.
[list][*] Every super destroyer will have its own leaderboard separate from everyone else. Anyone who is on your super destroyer can play a game and get added to the leaderboard. One entry per player, so one player cannot occupy multiple highscores.
[/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/2b59e5a88616c9c0602d1c8ea1de54e16466067c.png[/img]

[b][h3]General Gameplay[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*]Bug infestation zone visuals - [list]
[*] Bug infested zones, such as the areas around bug outposts and bug objectives, have had their visuals changed to integrate more with the biome/planet they’re on. Zones should now look more different from planet to planet.
[*]Bug infested zones have had their fog and effects adjusted for better visibility.
[*]These changes do not affect bug areas with larger degrees of infestation, such as areas inside the Gloom or on Hive Worlds.[/list]
[/list]

[b][h2]⚖️ Balancing[/h2][/b]

Enemy Spawning
Problem we want to solve:
[list]
[*] Sometimes enemies did not spawn in a balanced way between players if the team spread out over the map. We also sometimes used the enemy budget on enemies that were far away from players and were not really relevant to them.
[/list]
Intent and expectation with the changes:
[list]
[*] Enemy spawns are more balanced between separated helldivers on missions, giving all players a more consistent game experience.
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*]Enemy pressure on Helldivers is now measured based on enemies count and distance and used to balance enemy spawns.
[*]In a situation where a Helldiver is on low enemy pressure and the global enemies count reaches the maximum (set for performance reasons), enemies are preferably spawned near them.
This should address the feeling of roaming into empty outposts in such situations.
[*]When enemies count is over budget, far away enemies are despawned.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/a9572c8d3d3bf5eb39462663d38b90fd8d6d0317.png[/img]

[b]Balancing changes - EVACUATE HIGH-VALUE ASSETS:[/b]
Problem we want to solve:
[list]
[*] The missions have fallen behind in difficulty, making it so they feel boring and easy for many players that have access to good tools for these types of missions.
[/list]
Intent and expectation with the changes:
[list]
[*] The missions should feel more intense and be more difficult to complete, especially in lobbies with 3-4 players.
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*]Increased the maximum amount of waves.
[*]Reduced the time between waves to reduce downtime between each wave.
[list]
[*] Reduced the start time between waves from 60 seconds to 42 seconds (the time between waves at the start of the mission).
[*] Reduced the end time between waves from 40 seconds to 28 seconds (the time between waves at the end of the mission).
[*] Reduced the maximum time between waves from 10 seconds to 2 seconds (time between waves when finished the previous wave).
[/list]
[*]Increased amount of enemies that can spawn in each wave.
[list]
[*] Increased encounter points through the steps of the mission more exponentially.
[*] Increased encounter points when more players are present.
[/list]
[*]Enabled possibility to spawn SEAF troops, when included.
[/list]

Bug changes:
[list]
[*]Chance to spawn Shriekers.
[/list]

Level Design changes
[list]
[*]Randomized loot location and weapons.
[*]Added 3 random groups for loot like ammo, health kits, grenades, weapons.
[*]Added 10 common samples to collect throughout the mission.
[/list]

Mission Objective Changes:
[list]
[*]Added UI for each generator showing the health percentage.
[/list]

Primary weapons

AR/GL-21 One-Two
Problem we want to solve:
[list]
[*] The combination of the Assault rifle and underbarrel grenade launcher made it a flexible weapon, but the amount of ammunition for the grenade launcher did not make it useful enough.
[/list]
Intent and expectation with the changes:
[list]
[*] Lean more into what makes the One-Two different from other Assault rifles.
[*] It should be a flexible assault rifle that can use the underbarrel grenade launcher more often.
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*]Increased starting amount from 2 to 3
[*]Increased max spare amount from 3 to 5
[*]Increased refills from 3 to 5
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/a54af4a10ec377aad0fb40d21ad7f3895f51ea1a.png[/img]

LAS-13 Trident
Problem we want to solve:[list]
[*] Remove an unintended change that happened when we coded the functionality for the meltagun into the beam system which caused the Trident to become more impacted by vertical climb recoil.
[/list]
Intent and expectation with the changes:[list]
[*] The intent was not for the Trident to have that much vertical climb recoil. 
[*] The main intent for it was to have some recoil to make the weapon feel more impactful to shoot and not to be that much part of the weapons power level.
[/list]
Changes:[list]
[*]Decreased vertical climb recoil from 12 to 2
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/19369df443cca40ca54a938f02cd16ce3e5c7550.png[/img]

Throwables

G/40 Melta Mine
Problem we want to solve:
[list]
[*] Could attach to character and vehicle geometry in unintended ways.
[*] This could lead to:[/list][list][list][*] sticking to Helldivers and obscure the players vision (or griefing)
[*] sometimes attach to enemies and direct the explosion towards the player 
[*] floating mines in the air[/list][/list]
Intent and expectation with the changes:
[list]
[*]Should not stick to Helldivers and obscure the players vision
[*]Should not stick to Enemies or vehicles in unexpected angles
[*]Prevent melta mines from floating in the air
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*]The Melta Mine can no longer attach to characters and vehicles
[*]The Melta Mine can land and rest on sufficiently level surfaces of characters and vehicles
[*]The Mine will arm based on a timer from the throw unless it attaches to terrain
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/44f88b45a525bf1f3882e03eceed34496cbf8aab.png[/img]

Stratagems

Orbital Precision Strike
Problem we want to solve:[list]
[*] The Orbital precision strike has been falling behind other similar options in usability.
[/list]
Intent and expectation with the changes:
[list]
[*] Make it possible to use it more often and be closer in usability to similar options.
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*]Decreased cooldown from 90 to 80
[/list]



[b][h2]🔧 Fixes[/h2][/b]

[b]Crash Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash or network disconnect that could occur on levels with bunker caches in them
[*]Fixed a rare crash that could happen when hotjoining on Oil Rig missions
[*]Fixed a crash which could occur when cycling weapon functions whilst having the TED-63 Dynamite equipped and wielding a mounted weapon

[b]Weapons & Stratagem Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]GL-52 De-Escalator arc explosion can now hit the wielder of the weapon as intended.
[*]Fixed an issue causing eagle rearm being blocked by anti-air emplacements
[*]Fix wrongly displayed vehicles when cycling fast in the vehicle customization tab.
[*]Made several improvements to automatic weapons fire audio 
[/list]

[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Wretches and Crushers could clip through the floors of certain structures.
[*]The Spire Gazer will no longer stop firing when a target dies and will instead complete its whole firing cycle.

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*]Stim inputs will no longer buffer while you are in a vehicle/walker with the map open
[*]Fixed an issue where Message of the Day cannot be scrolled on PC using controllers
[*]Fixed the water levels on the Eradicate Illuminate Forces mission

[*]Fixed an issue where Helldivers failed to drown upon entering certain Illuminate water shrine wells. Death by drowning will now occur as intended
[*]Fixed an issue where the sub-objective "Retrieve Access Codes" sometimes incorrectly displayed as a primary objective in the "Shoot Down Overship" mission
[*]All illegal broadcasts in the galaxy have been upgraded with sound to make them even more illegal and un-democratic
[*]Fixed an issue in which some points of interest would not show as cleared in the minimap once all the samples got collected

newsitems.title: Let shockwaves of Freedom roll across the battlefield with Ironclad Democracy!
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p][b]Official transmission: Super Earth High Command.[/b][/p][p][b]FAO: All active units and potential new recruits.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Helldivers, the quickest route from tyranny to Liberty is one straight line of righteous operational advancement.[/p][p][/p][p]And today you have been granted clearance to forge a path clean through anti-Democratic resistance in your own creative way, armed with the brand-new Ironclad Democracy Warbond*.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6U5E3xGIAxw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Explosive. Decisive. Definitive. The latest technological advancements in battlefield problem-solving and innovative instruments of Freedom are yours to field test with maximum force and minimum restraint.[/p][p][/p][p]So, get to your Hellpods and join the trigger-happy YOLO rookies and the cunning, somehow-still-surviving campaign veterans of the Helldiver ranks en route to your nearest hostile hot zone in epic missions of industrial-scale Liberation.
[/p][p]Together you can overwhelm the diabolical forces of evil and crush peace-resistant hostiles under the inexorable Tracks of Justice.[/p][p][/p][p]Get out there, Helldivers, and create a legacy that will endure considerably longer than you do.
[/p][p]The Ironclad Democracy Warbond includes:
[/p][h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3][p][b]AR-11 Arbitrator[/b][/p][p]Primary – The electrical firing mechanism of this assault rifle releases caseless ammunition rounds in rapid succession, while the underslung shotgun delivers battlefield variety with a sudden and fatal surprise.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/107df7bbc9e9cbe0cf089b2b4964444dac726d3c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]GL-15 Evictor[/b][/p][p]Primary – Trade precision for devastating area-of-effect capabilities with a powerful pump-action grenade launcher. The manual single-round reload makes it a highly methodical choice for squads requiring an explosive approach to dispute resolution.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/40327ab6501afefe5a083b1b469036a0e3839de1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]P-34 Breacher[/b][/p][p]Secondary – Unholster this punishing missile pistol to burn through your target’s armor – or any outer layer – with sticky projectiles powered by phosphorous fuel and loaded with an explosive payoff.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Throwables[/b][/h3][p][b]G-60 Anti-Tank Seeker[/b][/p][p]Equipped with a high-yield payload especially effective against armored vehicles, this smart grenade delivery drone tracks the user’s movements before homing in on nearby enemies and exploding on impact.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/349220dbf2477a27e30a962a722aa6f0fe29796e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]G-8 Immolation[/b][/p][p]For you who likes to burn everything in your path. The immolation grenade sacrifices the boom for a blanket of fire to engulf your target in the blazing heart of Justice.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/56e150ece6524fa6501e3125ce9311810eb27d80.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Armor[/b][/h3][p][b]BFM-16 Tanker[/b][/p][p]Light Armor – Inspired by the legendary armored cavalry of the First Galactic War, this lightweight suit features integrated acoustic dampeners to shield the wearer from the deafening roar of Freedom… and the disruptive screams of dissidence.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BFM-220 Ironclad[/b][/p][p]Heavy Armor – Forged from surplus hull plating, this hulking suit features an integrated servo-bracing system and a towering blast-shield collar as favored by Helldiver barbershop quartets heard throughout the galaxy.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/f46c1326e57edb2e5e643df5f06fb012f8a9e5ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Armor Passive – Blunt-Force Mitigation[/b][/p][p]Makes Helldivers more resistant to being knocked off their feet when under attack and reduces any damage taken from impact and collisions by 30%, while also providing a higher armor rating.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Capes[/b][/h3][p][b]Standard of Rapid Evacuation[/b][/p][p]Adorned with a fearsome armored division crest, this abbreviated cape ensures the wearer's elite status is clearly broadcast to their subordinates, without the hem becoming fatally entangled in their own vehicle's heavy tread mechanisms.
[/p][p][b]Shroud of The Juggernaut[/b][/p][p]The sheer weight of this camouflage shroud perfectly complements a Helldiver operating as a walking tank. Astute observers will also note that the shattered woodland pattern conceals a highly classified, morale-boosting message in Morse code.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Boosters[/b][/h3][p][b]Surplus EAT Allocation[/b][/p][p]Enjoy two free uses of the Expendable Anti-Tank (EAT) Stratagem per mission; that’s enough to grant a full squad one single-use rocket launcher each, provided of course that all squad members employ the proper equipment distribution protocol as standard.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/929217f5a5abc0b66999a29edd47dac886d56764.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Integrated Extinguishers[/b][/p][p]For the Helldivers who like to play with fire, we have the Integrated Extinguishers Booster which reduces the time to extinguish flames if you accidentally set your teammates ablaze.
[/p][p][b]Plus[/b][/p][list][*][p]Emote – Helmet Durability Check.[/p][/*][*][p]Player Cards – Standard of Rapid Evacuation and Shroud of The Juggernaut.[/p][/*][*][p]Title – Treadhead.[/p][/*][*][p]A Premium Warbond First: Tank Exclusive Patterns – Verdant camouflage, Glacial polymer, and Executive onyx.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The Ironclad Democracy Warbond rolls onto the Galactic battlefield September 22nd.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/67b3eeee27405e3c8f51ba42f55dca82ce011f52.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]*Requires base game, Super Credits and game progression to unlock.[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: Behind the scenes: The Hive Lord
newsitems.author: Miitchimus
newsitems.contents:
[h1][b]The Origin of the Hive Lord[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Hello there! It is I, Niklas Malmborg, Design Director for Helldivers 2.[/p][p]Let’s talk about our old friend: the Hive Lord! And we can start with what he was back in the first game.[b]
[/b][/p][p]During the development of the original HELLDIVERS, we really liked the idea of a bossfight that was massive and fit the faction. The Terminids are a subterranean species, so a giant tunneling creature fits and has a certain nerdy allure to it for unrelated reasons.[/p][p]Being an important but so far not overly revealed part of the Terminid societal structure, it comes with a purpose to the Hive Worlds and it might be related to the tunnels the Helldivers “carefully” venture in to. Suggesting such a thing as a structure to Terminids society or even suggesting they have a society is a punishable offence of course. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/a5ebf12b682331af2e39aa2ac0fbf322ae893f91.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The first [i]HELLDIVERS[/i] serves as a source of content that players can look forward to because they know it’s a canon part of the universe (like the Bastion, Lumberer, Trident etc). We won't necessarily bring back everything from the first game, but we want to bring back a lot and the Hive Lord was near the top of the list.[/p][p]Due to technical limitations in the first game we made it as large as we could, but there was an urge to make it bigger and more majestic. Still, the resulting monster hit the emotional targets we were aiming for and players understood the potential scale of the Terminids.[/p][h2][b]How we Heralded it in HELLDIVERS 2[/b][/h2][p]In [i]HELLDIVERS 2,[/i] players have been able to see the bones of the Hive Lord as a beast of the past. We wanted those bones to serve as a promise to eventually show you the beast in its full glory and to be a motivator for us internally of what the game should eventually introduce.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/d80d9edaeb2ca1b8a8a70a97dba0977e310fd899.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]So how did we approach it?[/b][/h2][p]We started with making a list - of everything that the Hive Lord needs to be and have in order to be the biggest, baddest Terminid life form (so far). This is what we decided: [/p][p](some of the text is not perfect sentences, its copy pasted from the working documents)[/p][p][b]1. MASSIVE[/b][/p][p]An impressive scale and cinematic appearance to instill awe and fear.[/p][p][b]2. ELUSIVE[/b][/p][p]Only appears on certain planets, and only sometimes. [/p][p][b]3. BURROWER [/b][/p][p]Underground traversal, deforming terrain as it moves and erupts, arcing and diving like a dolphin.[/p][p][b]4. GRATUITOUS VIOLENCE [/b][/p][p]Simple movement, attack, and death. It’s head/top visible while navigating half-submerged in terrain. A simple-yet-massive acid spray to destroy players. [/p][p][b]5. HARD TO KILL[/b][/p][p]It has a massive health pool that's reflected physically on its body/segments to show players how much damage they've done.[/p][p][b]6. BAIT [/b][/p][p]Players can influence Hive Lord behavior using both discreet and explicit tactics. Hive Lord has readable roaming behavior and provides opportunity for bait mastery. [/p][p](Yeah, it detects disturbances of the earth, so you can bait it with explosions, barrages etc. Or it can find you if you’re too noisy in combat. [i]Have fun![/i])[/p][p]
[/p][p]With our list completed, we prioritized our work and knew that, if we hit all the points, we would have made a truly monstrous Terminid. [/p][p]Here are a few of our images of the development and some more specific notes:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/f9ba18e526b07bb360466ef260250edb5dd21bf8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]Animation:[/p][p]In the animation files we ended up using Motionbuilder and a Human IK rig for the Hive Lord, meaning his whole body is made up of a human neck, with the head at the end and the rest of the body at the base. In the source files there are therefore tiny tiny human arm and leg joints around the base of the character that never gets exported. [/p][p]Sound: [/p][p]The sound team also used a chair dragging against the floor as part of building the iconic sound the Hive Lord makes as it erupts. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/33d118fedcc20906bc954bb9f4449f184ba4c659.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/1fa5d0b0811abe6aa25c7f8d69497441d6ade57b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Performance and Rendering: [/p][p]We had to develop a lot of new tech to make sure this very large enemy didn't impair performance and memory for players so it functions in segments compared to normal enemies where we render and treat them only as one piece![/p][p]Movement:[/p][p]Previously, all of our enemies used a navigation mesh that dictates where they can move, what type of movement is allowed, and where. The Hive Lord is so massive that we needed to make one specifically for him! It also has different logic, like not moving on rocky terrain, and creates its own map of disturbances (from vehicles, explosions, etc.) to choose where to navigate to.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/b12228477aef31502f561da85c1032074b476c15.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]It doesn’t have a bossfight mission? But it had one in HELLDIVERS![/b][/h2][p]In HELLDIVERS the Hive Lord could only be found in a separate mission focused only on killing the boss. Why isn't it like this in HELLDIVERS 2?[/p][p]One thing we actually thought didn't work well in the first game was the bossfights. After you played them a handful of times they became very predictable and repetitive - and that didn’t feel right for HELLDIVERS 2 or for the Hive Lord.[/p][p]Instead, we thought of the Hive Lord like a force of nature, almost invincible. It roams around the map, churning up the land, stalking players, and creating an anticipatory atmosphere. Players get the chance to [i]try [/i]to beat the big scary monster, but are not forced to. It’s possible for players to take on this ridiculously powerful boss enemy, but it's no easy task.[/p][p]
[/p][p]I hope you enjoyed this little dive into the development of the Hive Lord, that's it for this week! I[i] [/i]will be back in the future to talk about more exciting development stories![/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Helldivers 2: A deep dive into the Illuminate Void
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]Helldivers, we have entered the unknown at last to face the unthinkable. Our elite peacekeepers are looking into the corruption and shining Liberty’s light onto the heart of darkness. The Gateway is constructed and we have crossed into the new frontier.
[/p][p align="start"]The Illuminate may have broken through but Super Earth will push back. Now is the time to mount the counteroffensive! You must work together to destroy their unnatural mutations in the name of Managed Democracy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/4a8ae1412eb1e1e2550ba88ca606d458bdf36f49.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]The Gateway is now open[/b][/h2][p align="start"]During the ‘Census Thunder’ campaign, the Helldivers secured large reserves of Voteless tissue samples from the Void to aid in the study of this menace. Super Earth’s Ministry of Science determined a way into the Void by opening and stabilizing a wormhole on Rirga Bay using the research you helped secure: the Gateway is now open.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/31f4a910470b84f58b32e5561355373990e94cb5.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We’re sending our best, Helldivers. And that means you.[/p][h2][b]Liberate The Source Planet[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Space inside the Void is strange, divers. There are no stars, no marvelous skies to behold from the planet’s surface. The planets pulled into the Void have been transformed, mutated, and reborn inside it.[/p][p align="start"]These worlds hold Illuminate ruins and ancient technologies that you must document and destroy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/2a617a085e578c0dc917597e92ccddd2a704082f.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]You must navigate these strange worlds and find the Source Planet, formerly known as Seasse, and liberate it. But beware: Seasse is a shade of its former glory, now consumed by the haunting flora from the Void, and filled with Illuminate horrors (the Wretch, the Crusher and the abominable lands in which they dwell)[/p][h2][b]Document the Corruption[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Inside the Void, you have new objectives to complete on the planets, and–unlike previously more linear dives–you will have several randomized primary objectives for every operation. This brand new arrangement requires you to think fast and work together to dive and extract safely.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/4b73d82d7e41a2f1222643384833fc794cb2b149.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Document your discoveries inside the Void with the tactical video camera, destroying Illuminate structures, conducting reconnaissance missions, and more. Document their war crimes and end their foul corruption.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/61521863da90648fa45f233db463af9f6ec0ff00.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Extract the Squad[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The Void is dangerous and time is of the essence: complete objectives and extract. To give your squad a fighting chance at making it back to the Destroyer, Helldivers will be able to unlock secondary extraction zones on the Void planets.[/p][p align="start"]You won’t be facing these new challenges alone. Push forward with the help of SEAF support squads to unravel the secrets of the Void. Reveal the hidden truths, uncover the source of the anomaly… and put Freedom’s foot clean through its face.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/b5f175f4b4fece9753b241586d3169d3e844f382.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The fight for a safer tomorrow begins today.[/p][p align="start"]The latest update, Devoid of Liberty[i]***[/i], is live now. Take back the galaxy, divers–give these squids [i]hell.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]***Gameplay requires internet access and paid-for subscription on console (sold separately).[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: HELLDIVERS 2 Devoid of Liberty Update Out Now
newsitems.author: PS_13
newsitems.contents: [p]We have watched the Void stretch across the galaxy for too long. The threat posed to our Liberty is too great and we can no longer stand by as the Illuminate gain ground. [/p][p]Helldivers, you are needed on the battlefield of a new frontier–one more wild and uncertain than any we have faced prior. We must venture into their haunted abyss, the Void, and liberate it back into Super Earth’s control.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Journey to the Void[/b][/h3][p]Getting into the Void presents a unique challenge. High Command has ordered reconnaissance missions to gather as much intel as possible in order to give us an advantage.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/f8daff64932d92724ceaf7a21ba27a996ba9ad7a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The planets within the Void’s reach have been altered–strange mutations have left a permanent mark on planets, and intelligence reports suggest that these changes are even more significant the closer the planets are to the Void itself. What lies inside?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/deb9afb84d646a245ea25d48e62dfb8eb35ebff8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Complete new missions[/b][/h3][p]You will be given new objectives to conquer–destroy Illuminate spires and gateways, complete data reconnaissance, and infiltrate Illuminate structures with your team. [/p][p]New secondary objectives will also become available, from eradicating Void mutations to extracting materials for research, as well as the opportunity to open a secondary extraction zone on the map to potentially evacuate your squad faster. [/p][h3][b]Exterminate new threats[/b][/h3][p]As you fight your way toward the Void, you’ll encounter new, hideously mutated organisms. We have received intelligence reports that indicate these metamorphosed creatures are emerging from the heart of the Void–they are ghoulish diversions wrought into existence by the Illuminate scourge to threaten our freedom. [/p][p][b]The Wretch[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/8dae5f0d969f551e71d111f71b9fba57ceff082d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The nimble Wretch moves fast and can easily overwhelm weaker fighters and dodge their counter-attacks–don’t let it get the jump on you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Crusher[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/cec3c3d3ded82dfc0038b501945d0a42aa6bac6b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]On a relentless death march, the Crusher can take heavy damage and also dish it out. Wear it down before it regenerates. [/p][h3][b]Dive with more impact[/b] [/h3][p]We aren’t sending you in without backup. You may now gain all 300 ranks of security access and privileges, as well as new rank titles. [/p][p][/p][p]We have commissioned SEAF platoons to aid in completing operations. They’ll arrive on dropships to fight alongside you and your squad, offering medical support via stims, but also give a boost to your morale when you salute, shake hands, and–of course–hug them. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/90ba75683138f9739b746faceae7602ddf6fb460.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is our opportunity to strike and avenge the citizens, SEAF, and Helldivers lost in the Battle for Super Earth.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Helldivers 2 Super Merch store[/b][/h3][p] Helldivers 2 Super Merch is now available for those dedicated to the pursuit of Liberty and Democracy. Super Earth recognizes your accomplishments with special merchandise for purchase; complete in-game achievements in Helldivers 2 to unlock this merchandise on the Helldivers 2 Super Merch store*. Want to see what Helldivers 2 Super Merch is available to you? Simply sign on to the Helldivers 2 Super Merch store using your preferred platform.[/p][p][/p][p]The latest update, Devoid of Liberty[i]**[/i], is live now on PS5, PC, and Xbox. Take back the galaxy, divers–give these squids [i]hell.[/i][/p]

[p]I'm your host, [b]Release Captain Morris[/b]. When humanity is at stake, we bring you this update from [b]Super Earth High Command[/b] to further your efforts in the war.[/p][p][/p][p][b]*** INCOMING TRANSMISSION FROM SUPER EARTH HIGH COMMAND ***[/b][/p][p]Helldivers, you are needed on the battlefield of a new frontier–one more wild and uncertain than any we have faced prior. We are so close to entering the Void.[/p][p]
Stay frosty, divers. As you fight your way toward the Void, you’ll encounter new, hideously mutated organisms. We have received intelligence reports that indicate these metamorphosed creatures are emerging from the heart of the Void–they are ghoulish diversions wrought into existence by the Illuminate scourge to threaten our freedom. [/p][p]
[/p][p]We aren’t sending you in without backup. You may now gain all 300 ranks of security access and privileges, and we have commissioned SEAF platoons  to aid you on the surface of the Void source planet.[/p][p]
[/p][p]This is our opportunity to strike and avenge the citizens, SEAF, and Helldivers lost in the Battle for Super Earth.[/p][p]
This is our chance to destroy them.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/a09aaea6d190f7143c3b15fe4cc2bae3d9d03696.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]📍 [b]Patch Highlights[/b][/h2][p]
[/p][p][b]New Illuminate Enemies[/b][/p][p]A new biome full of fresh horrors awaits, the void warps everything it touches and your foes have taken new hideous forms.[/p][list][*][p]The Crusher is on a deathmarch capable of regenerating while taking heavy damage and needs to be worn down quickly and consistently without a moment of pause.[/p][/*][*][p]The Wretch is a relentless and nimble enemy that requires quick trigger fingers and focused aim as they are able to dodge and leap at the player while advancing to quickly dismantle its weapons along with their will to live.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
SEAF Support [/b][/p][p]SEAF have entered the battle! [/p][p]Super Earth Armed Forces (SEAF) can now appear as a planet modifier, joining you in battle in your missions and enhancing your combat capabilities with a range of new tools (Stim pistols, Heavy Machine guns and more)[/p][list][*][p]The SEAF take to the stars. Super Earth High Command has mandated the SEAF be deployed directly to the frontlines of the Galactic Campaign for Democracy. Helldivers will be able to be supported by friendly SEAF NPC troops, with new and improved behavior, weaponry and updated visuals
 [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level Cap Increased[/b][/p][p]We've expanded the Helldiver rank system beyond Level 150, adding 15 new ranks and titles that carry Helldivers all the way up to Level 300. Each new rank comes with its own unique title and icon to recognize the most dedicated defenders of Managed Democracy. Super Earth thanks you for your continued service, the fight never ends, and neither does your potential.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Expanded Emote Slots[/b][/p][p]Helldivers, you now have twice as many ways to express yourself on the battlefield! The emote wheel capacity has been raised from 4 to 8 emotes.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]CASTELLAN'S CREED Warbond[/b][/p][p]Channel the formidable battle prowess of the Astra Militarum’s finest in the HELLDIVERS™ 2 x Warhammer 40,000: Castellan’s Creed Legendary Warbond.

[/p][h3][b]🤝 Community Feedback Changes[/b][/h3][p]We’re trying out a new section to shout out some of the fixes and changes that are high up on the community’s wishlist![/p][p]
[/p][p][b]GATER Upgrades[/b]
Super Earth engineers have replaced the engine and transmission in the GATER in favor of a much more powerful Super V48 Interceptor engine, this has improved its speed and handling.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]The Constitution[/b][/p][p]… has stripper clips! 

[/p][p][b]Assisted Reload Rework[/b][/p][p]Problem we want to solve: [/p][list][*][p]The original intent was a tactical action that needed collaboration with a designated reloader that carries the backpack[/p][/*][*][p]We have reevaluated how this works and with how the game has evolved since launch we got to the conclusion that the assisted reload action require too much coordination which lead to it rarely happening[/p][/*][/list][p]Intent and expectation with the change:[/p][list][*][p]We want to reduce the complexity with assisted reloading to promote using it more.[/p][/*][*][p]Allow players to keep their backpack and reload whenever you need, while also allows a teammate to easily help you if the opportunity arises. [/p][/*][/list][p]The change we made:[/p][list][*][p]Helldivers can now assist reload as long as one of the wielder and/or reloader of the weapon has the correct backpack[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]⚖️ [b]Balancing[/b] [/h1][p][/p][h2]Updated icons for backpack weapons and expendable weapons[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Problem we want to solve: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Find a specific weapon in the loadout can be hard to do with all the new weapons added to the arsenal[/p][/*][*][p]It can be hard to know if a support weapon needs a backpack or can not be reloaded when only looking at the icon.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Intent and expectation with the change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We want to make it easier to find specific weapons and to plan your loadout. [/p][/*][*][p]It should be easier to know when a weapon needs a backpack or can not be reloaded when only looking at the icon.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The change we made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stratagem Weapons that require a backpack now have a backpack icon included on their loadout icons [/p][/*][*][p]Stratagem Weapons that can not be reloaded now have a drop weapon icon included on their loadout icons .[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Decreased heavy landing duration[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Problem we want to solve: [/b][/p][list][*][p]The original intent was to make the heavy landing to feel like you recovered from a high fall.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The player lost control for a long time when landing on the feet from a higher fall.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Intent and expectation with the change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We wanted to make it smoother to recover from the heavy landing state and not remove the control for too long.[/p][/*][*][p]While still make it feel like a heavy landing recovery[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The change we made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased the duration for the heavy landing animation with around 40%[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Stim action input smoothing[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Problem we want to solve: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can experience dead input when trying to stim when the stim action was not allowed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Intent and expectation with the change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We want to lessen the feeling of dead input when using the stim action.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The change we made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We changed so the stim input is remembered for a short duration when the action is not allowed and will be executed if the stim action is allowed within that duration. [/p][/*][*][p]This works similar to how the reload input action changes from the last patch.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Ammo re-balance for Short magazines attachments and Secondaries [/h2][p][/p][p][b]Problem we want to solve: [/b][/p][list][*][p]The benefits of the short magazines are too few compared to drum magazines.[/p][/*][*][p]The benefits of some of the anti personnel side arms do not have enough benefits compared to other side arm options.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Intent and expectation with the change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Give more benefits to short magazines to make the items more useful compared to drum magazines for the same weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Give more benefits to some of the lesser used anti personnel side arms to make the items more useful[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The change we made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Short magazines got more max spare and starting magazines.[/p][/*][*][p]Some of the anti personnel sidearms got more max spare and starting magazines.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Primaries[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/3cf225f4457c412a424b52a1838be8a30b64c689.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]R-2124 Constitution[/b][/p][p]Added a full stripper clip reload when reloading if the magazine is empty.[/p][p][/p][h3]Primaries attachments[/h3][p][b]Short magazines for:[/b][/p][p][b]AR-23 Liberator[/b][/p][p][b]AR-23P Liberator Penetrator[/b][/p][p][b]AR-23C Liberator Concussive[/b][/p][p][b]AR-23A Liberator Carbine [/b][/p][p][b]AR-59 Suppressor[/b][/p][p]Increased spare magazines 12 to 16[/p][p]Increased starting magazines 7 to 9[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Short magazines for:[/b][/p][p][b]SMG-37 Defender [/b][/p][p][b]SMG-72 Pummeler[/b][/p][p]Increased spare magazines 9 to 12[/p][p]Increased starting magazines 6 to 8[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Short magazines for:[/b][/p][p][b]SMG/FLAM-34 Stoker [/b][/p][p]Increased spare magazines 10 to 13[/p][p]Increased starting magazines 6 to 7[/p][p]Decreased reload duration 2.8 sec to 2.3 sec [/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Short magazines for:[/b][/p][p][b]SG-225 Breaker[/b][/p][p][b]SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary[/b][/p][p]Increased magazines spare magazines 9 to 11[/p][p]Increased magazines starting magazines 6 to 7[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Short magazines for:[/b][/p][p][b]SG-225SP Breaker Spray&Pray[/b][/p][p]Increased spare magazines 16 to 20[/p][p]Increased starting magazines 11 to 12[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Secondaries[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/913b071d4590dae60097cc90f1d1f908b79b7863.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]P-113 Verdict[/b][/p][p]Increased max spare magazines from 8 to 10[/p][p]Increased starting magazines from 4 to 6[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]M6C/SOCOM Pistol[/b][/p][p]Increased max spare magazines from 8 to 10[/p][p]Increased starting magazines from 5 to 6[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]P-19 Redeemer[/b][/p][p]Increased spare magazines from 4 to 6[/p][p][/p][h2]Stratagems [/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/cec3c3d3ded82dfc0038b501945d0a42aa6bac6b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Eagle Napalm Airstrike[/b][/p][p][b]Problem we want to solve: [/b][/p][list][*][p]The Eagle napalm did not feel as effective compared to other Eagle stratagems and napalm stratagems[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Intent and expectation with the change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Create a larger area of effect for the napalms fire[/p][/*][*][p]Make it more effective compared to other napalm stratagems[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The change we made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased explosion radius 8 to 10m[/p][/*][*][p]More spread out bomb pattern to cover a larger area[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines[/b][/p][p][b]Problem we want to solve: [/b][/p][list][*][p]The explosion of the mines looks like they can destroy larger things[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Intent and expectation with the change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The effect of the explosion match should match the visuals better[/p][/*][*][p]Make the mines work in more situations like destroying colony walls and bug holes from the outside[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The change we made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Demolition strength from 30 to 40[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Enemies[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/930532a13ff062d667bd8e6ae0476caa41141e92.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Terminids[/h2][p][/p][h3]Hunters[/h3][p][b]Problem we want to solve: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Hunters and their variants were unable to attack FRVs consistently [/p][/*][*][p]They could only use their tongue to attack, and struggle to find a proper position to launch it[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Intent and expectation with the change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When Helldivers enter a FRV, Hunters should be able to attack the vehicle more naturally [/p][/*][/list][p][b]The change we made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We allowed one melee attack to be correctly triggered against FRVs [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]
[/p][h2]Illuminate[/h2][p][/p][h3]Veracitor [/h3][p][b]Problem we want to solve: [/b][/p][list][*][p]When the Helldiver got attacked by a Veracitor while holding a ballistic shield it could created clipping issue where the arm of the Veracitor could merge with the body of the Helldiver and sometime resulting in sending the Helldiver at high speed in the air[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Intent and expectation with the change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fighting an exomech with a ballistic shield still protects against damage, but Helldivers will now ragdoll when blocking an attack[/p][/*][*][p]Helldivers won’t be sent to low orbit anymore after blocking an attack with ballistic shield.[/p][/*][/list][p]Ballistic shield will break after around 15 direct hits[/p][p][b]The change we made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Exomech melee’s force strength from 25 to 40[/p][/*][*][p]Conformed Exomech melee’s attack armor penetration to all correctly be Anti tank[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]🔧 [b]Fixes[/b][/h2][p]
[/p][h3][b]Crash Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed rare crash that could happen when dropping down the core drill[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash which could occur when spreading fire[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a very rare crash which could occur when mortar sentries update their targeting aim[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could happen sometimes when dropping in on CR7+ missions on Cyberstan[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare UI crash on shutdown[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when using multiple monitors with different DPI scales in Windows [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Weapons & Stratagem Fixes[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Sway and reload weapon stats now display decimals for better accuracy[/p][/*][*][p]Stratagem Weapons that require a backpack now have a backpack icon included on their loadout icons [/p][/*][*][p]Stratagem Weapons that cannot be reloaded now have a drop weapon icon included on their loadout icons [/p][/*][*][p]You can now assist reload a Helldiver, using ammo from their backpack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed glitch where Veto pistol would receive one extra round (translating to one extra 6 bullet reload!) from the Siege-Ready armor passive. [/p][list][*][p]Also corrects a few other weapons which also received one erroneous extra round, magazine or heat-coil. We continue to round partial bonus rounds/mags/coils up in favor of the player. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the camera clipped through the R-36 Eruptor with 2x Tube Red Dot equipped when inserting the next bullet in ADS at max FoV[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will no longer spontaneously attack the GATER unless the Helldiver is inside it or unless they are drilling. Enemies famously hate the democratic extraction of natural resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons will no longer lock onto the tank of the GATER[/p][/*][*][p]Increased GATER ammo capacity, health, knockback and impact damage. Also made it harder to roll sideways[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed and responsiveness of the GATER[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the first person animation of the LAS-58 Talon overloading would make the weapon clip with the SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Helldiver would cancel draw animations if they tried to enter the aim state while switching weapons. This would cause the Helldiver to look ready to fire, while still preparing the weapon[/p][/*][*][p]The Ministry of Defence user experience department have made improvements to the TD-220 Bastion Mk.XVI munitions system Heads Up Display. This should make it clearer the main canon can be reloaded manually.[/p][/*][*][p]Orbital Laser will no longer occasionally get stuck after targeting a flying enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Exosuits will no longer get stuck in trees when being dropped off[/p][/*][*][p]Throwable items are now being visible to other players when the Helldiver is carrying them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the EXO-55 Breakthrough Exosuit would sometimes have the shield arm damage zones protrude through the shield, resulting in the arm taking damage that the shield should have protected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed case where the Breaker Drill could get stuck on the roof in certain hive world missions[/p][/*][*][p]M-104 Incinerator FRV's mounted flamethrower now shows the correct icon and name[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Gatekeeper's weapons clipped into each other when their target was too close[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where visually removing the armor of the Impaler didn't match the gameplay experience[/p][/*][*][p]Impaler close melee attack now has a damage shockwave[/p][/*][*][p]Hunters are now able to attack FRVs more consistently[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where enemies would disappear when the Helldiver died, thus not being able to know what just killed the Helldiver[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy navigation issues in one of the Take Down Overship locations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Veracitor's melee attack could clip through Helldivers holding a SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Watchers and Obtruders were not attacking players while mounted behind a Grenadier Battlement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sometimes the Hive Lord scales would not visually break properly (did not affect gameplay behavior)[/p][/*][*][p]Obtruder will now collide correctly with Helldivers[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced clipping between Obtruder and Helldivers' vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Veracitors now guard outposts[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Veracitor clipped through buildings and obstacles while charging. It should now destroy anything in its path and stop when hitting a wall[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Veracitor clipped through buildings and obstacles while charging. It should now destroy anything in its path and stop when hitting a wall[/p][/*][*][p]Gatekeeper spawnrate has been increased to closely match Veracitor in Encounters[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug for Gatekeeper sometimes appearing to turn in place without moving their legs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug which would on rare occasions cause enemies to not be able to move into the correct attack range[/p][/*][*][p]SEAFs can destroy enemy spawners[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies have learned how to climb stairs during the Establish Communication Uplink missions[/p][/*][/list][p]
