[/p][list][*][p]Fixed several mission HUD inconsistencies on certain Hiveworld missions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visible holes in the terrain in one of the Disrupt Shield Generator locations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the factory building facade was inverted[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the sounds for picking up medals, requisition slips and super credits one of the missions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Recoil Simulator was showing all ammo being fired at once[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle delivery shuttles will no longer get stuck endlessly looking for a place to drop off their deliveries when deployed in dense cities between tall buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Helldivers will no longer ride the victory elevator with their hands in the air like some kind of rollercoaster[/p][/*][*][p]Helldivers how have a chance to find super credits in Factory Worlds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the tutorial where the incoming timer for the Orbital Precision Strike could display an incorrect duration[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized various gameplay VFX across the game[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented hit-markers being displayed for hits from indirect explosive damage, damage from your sentries and damage from your orbitals/airstrikes. newsitems.title: HELLDIVERS 2 Is Raising the Level Cap to 300
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]Attention, Helldivers. Super Earth has authorized a new tier of service, and it's a big one: the level cap is jumping from [b]150 all the way to 300[/b].[/p][p]If you are already sore from the democratic path to 150, take a breath before you panic, this update comes with some genuinely great news for anyone who's already put in the hours.[/p][h2][b]A Quick History of the Cap[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Launch cap:[/b] Level 50[/p][/*][*][p][b]April 2024:[/b] Tripled to level 150[/p][/*][*][p][b]Now:[/b] Doubling again to level 300[/p][/*][/list][p]Each time the cap has risen, it's been paired with new titles, ranks, and bragging rights for the players who've stuck around–from our veterans of Malevelon Creek, to our soldiers in the Battle for Super Earth, to those brave divers who held the Menkent Line and beyond. This time is no different; level 300 is arriving as part of a broader progression overhaul that also brings Galactic War Campaigns and Personal Campaign Progression tracks, giving you new rewarding goals to chase even when the wider community's Major Order doesn't pan out.[/p][h2][b]The Numbers[/b][/h2][p]Let's be honest about what we're looking at here:[/p][list][*][p]Reaching [b]level 150[/b] already takes many, many hours of dedicated sessions… Several hundreds of missions across dozens of Galactic War campaigns.[/p][/*][*][p]Reaching [b]level 300[/b] will take more than double that. This isn't a small bump; it's a genuine second act for anyone chasing the next rank.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you're not already at the cap, don't stress about "falling behind." All the weapons, stratagems, and gear that actually matter for your loadout unlock by around level 25. Everything past that is about demonstrating your veteran prestige and prowess in battle. Level 300 is a marathon–not a sprint–designed to let you continue to demonstrate to your fellow Helldivers your skill and commitment to fighting for Super Earth.[/p][h2][b]The Best Part: Your XP Is Already Banked[/b][/h2][p]Here's the part worth getting excited about. If you hit level 150 before this patch drops and kept playing anyway, [b]none of that XP was wasted.[/b][/p][p]The game has saved every drop of experience you earned over 150; even past the current cap. The moment the new limit goes live, the game recalculates your total XP against the new level table and instantly bumps you up to wherever you should be. No re-grinding, no starting over. Just an immediate jump that reflects the missions you’ve already completed with your fellow divers, the battles you’ve already won, and the contributions you’ve already made to the ongoing war.[/p][p]This is exactly what happened the last time the cap rose from 50 to 150: players who'd kept farming missions past level 50 logged in and found themselves instantly promoted several levels, sometimes dozens, based purely on banked XP. Expect the same behavior this time around.[/p][p]So if you've been running Super Helldive missions "for nothing" since hitting 150, surprise, you've actually been quietly stacking up levels 151, 152, 153, and beyond. You just haven't seen the number tick over yet.[/p][h2][b]What This Means Going Forward[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New veteran players (already at 150):[/b] Log in after the patch and watch your level jump based on banked XP. Keep playing normally in the meantime, every dive counts💪.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Players still working toward 150:[/b] No change to your path. Keep pushing toward the current cap; the new ceiling will be waiting for you.[/p][/*][/list][p]Expect new titles and ranks to fill out the stretch between 150 and 300, giving long-term players fresh milestones (and hopefully some fresh bragging rights) all the way to the new ceiling.[/p][p]For Super Earth, for glory, and for that sweet, sweet liberty! See you on the battlefield, Helldivers.[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: EA’s Saudi takeover will be "a real waste" if it turns the publishers into a "sequel-and-mega-franchise machine", Helldivers 2 studio boss says
newsitems.contents:
Well, it's happened. EA's thumbs up from the European Commission, the $55 billion leveraged buyout by Saudi Arabia, Silver Lake and Jared Kushner-founded investment firm Affinity Partners has gone through. With the publishers now privately owned and saddled with a bunch of debt, questions loom about what their future will look like.

The CEO of Helldivers 2 studio Arrowhead, Shams Jorjani, hopes the answer won't be EA narrowing further into "a sequel-and-mega-franchise machine".

Система теперь отслеживает аномально высокую скорость заработка «Супер Кредитов» — внутриигровой валюты, за которую открываются боевые пропуска с оружием и бронёй. newsitems.title: Super Credits & A Fairer Galactic War
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p][i]Cheaters have been a top topic in player feedback since launch, and today we are united in dealing a hefty blow to their undemocratic ways!
[/i][/p][p]Greetings, Helldivers.[/p][p]You've told us that cheaters and exploiters ruin the experience that it feels unfair when someone games the Super Credit system while you're out there earning yours the hard way. We heard you, and we're starting to implement changes that will tackle issues like this...[/p][p]Today we’re improving our monitoring methods for suspicious Super Credit activity. Here's exactly what that means for you.
[/p][h3][b]TL;DR [/b][/h3][p]If you earn credits at an unreasonably high rate (substantially higher than the highest players earning ever recorded) there are now steps in place to counter this. This will not affect legitimate players, only the bad apples cheating the system. 
[/p][h3][b]Good news first: this changes nothing for real Helldivers.[/b][/h3][p]If you're playing the game grinding maps, clearing POIs, looting bunkers you will never experience any change. So keep on liberating with your squad on a marathon grind, or even a full weekend of play. The cap exists to catch bad actors, not to slow you down.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]So who [i]does[/i] this affect?[/b][/h3][p]Cheaters. Botters. People using automation and duplication exploits to hoover up Super Credits at rates no human Helldiver could ever reach legitimately. Those are the targets and now we have radically improved the tools to stop them at the source, before they can do damage to the economy you play in.[/p][p]By drawing a firm line, we can:[/p][list][*][p]Catch and stop cheating at the point of exploit not after the harm is done.[/p][/*][*][p]Keep earned rewards meaningful, so your Super Credits actually feel worth having.[/p][/*][*][p]Level the playing field across every planet and every player population.[/p][/*][*][p]And of course allow you legitimate players to keep as many super credits as you earn,  forever![/p][/*][*][p]These changes will be rolling out for all reward currencies including Medals, Samples, and Requisition[/p][/*][/list][p]This is a win for the community. A healthier economy means the Super Credits you earn through honest service to Super Earth stay worth earning.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What if something seems off with your account?[/b][/h3][p]We know changes like this can raise questions. The player support team is ready to review your case.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Reach out to support here:[/b]

 [url="https://arrowhead.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new" style="pill"]Arrowhead Player Support[/url][/p][p][/p][p]You told us the fight wasn't fair. Today marks a big step towards eradicating pesky cheaters. We'll keep listening and keep communicating openly as we continue to improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p]For Super Earth. For Democracy. For a cheat-free galaxy.[/p]

newsitems.title: Celebrating our community
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]Freedoms Greetings Helldivers, [/p][p][/p][p]Our devs are hard at work on a Hot Fix for the game, more info to be shared on that next week. [/p][p][/p][p]So we wanted to use today's blog to celebrate an amazing initiative from players within our community: “HEROES 2026”, The Freedom Alliance annual fundraiser with Save The Children.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/53abd303d20cb9c6daf5a88c5a8145a0a1c5a4ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Freedom Alliance is the largest independent community for Helldivers 2 boasting over 50,000 active members across Discord and their website ([url="https://www.freedomalliance.gg/"]https://www.freedomalliance.gg/[/url]). Freedom Alliance runs a wealth of community activities, from community-driven orders to news broadcasts to the HEROES fundraiser that just ended on June 28.
[/p][p]Stemming from a [u][url="https://x.com/helldivers2/status/1800533719985311947"]Major Order[/url][/u] 2 years ago, when the mighty Helldivers opted to forgo the MD-17 Anti-Tank Mine stratagem for a third time (much to the surprise of us here at the studio) and save children trapped in Super Citizen Anne's hospital on Vernen Wells. The Freedom Alliance has since turned this into their tentpole event every year. Teaming up with the Save The Children foundation and auctioning off a range of cool items signed by us here at Arrowhead Game Studios, along with other amazing items made by people within the community.[/p][p][/p][p]This year's event took another major leap by partnering with one of our Propaganda Commanders, Commissar Kai, and a wealth of other core community members to add a Streamathon. The Streamathon helped raise even more money, more than double the amount raised in 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]We also wanted to take time to shout out some of the other community members who got involved, although there were approximately 155 in total, but shout out to[/p][p]Tinatheterror, Pyschyari, mst0fu, MichelleFreeHugs, thecolebrew, StriderofValor, LhilaKalkari, Demostorm, BuckFoozle, Tana_Sukke, Maplewood_tv, ses-vanguard (Super Earth Salute), Red Monster Thing, Glitch Unlimited, Plot Coalition, TyBrowGames, Ionic, KuroTamxshi, young_neoth, Wallbouncing, Noofrius, namenrumerals, jay_the_gam3r, UnicornElectrick,Bricky,  tizzytheprophet, Super Earth GWDA, Quartermaster Creature, the Rocky_Mountain_Helldivers, HD2绝地潜兵情报站 / 麦咾源Bingo / 半角数字君 / lcyf166 / StuGIV突击炮 / 刻燕Kyan_Official / 叶歌儿丶 / 快乐lalaB, and many more.[/p][p][/p][p]You can view the Stream recap here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t2Jwb5oxTS4"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]So again, from the bottom of our hearts we want to show our deepest gratitude for all of you who got involved, whether through a mission on Yed Prior or donating on their website. Super Earth salutes you. Hopefully it can be even bigger next year! [/p][p][/p][p]Now, Back to Diving![/p][p]

newsitems.title: Machinery of Oppression: 6.3.0
newsitems.author: Elemdil
newsitems.contents:
[p][i]Release Captain Morris coming to you this democratic Tuesday with an update from High Command.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Attention Helldivers,[/p][p][/p][p]High Command has authorized a significant tactical update with both content and quality of life upgrades. We are deploying Helldivers in new Galactic Campaigns, making upgrades to the new diver training program, and making essential fixes and upgrades across the board.[/p][p]
[/p][p]We have also made changes to weapon, stratagem, and enemy balancing based on feedback from Helldivers on the frontlines, including reductions to enemy durable damage and a decreased exosuit cooldown.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Helldivers, we are committed to making the necessary upgrades to keep you in the fight. Because you have never given up on Managed Democracy, we will never give up on making it easier for you to spread.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/be565f52b0208369f63985e1e9f2dba104148df3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patch Highlights[/b][/h2][list][*][p]New Galactic Campaigns[/p][/*][*][p]New “Control Center” terminal for Campaigns & Major Orders[/p][/*][*][p]New Biome - Forest (Fall)[/p][/*][*][p]Bastion Tank Patterns[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle Armour and Enemies Armour Penetration (AP) Rebalance[/p][/*][*][p]Sentry Health Rebalance[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Rebalances[/p][list][*][p]Including Durable Damage Reductions[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reloading Improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Exo Suit Cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Rebalances[/p][list][*][p]Throwable Amount Rebalance[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] Stratagem Rebalances [/p][list][*][p]Orbital Damage Rebalance[/p][/*][*][p]Speargun and Sterilizer Rebalance[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Crash Fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon & Stratagem Fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]
Introducing the CONTROL CENTER terminal
[/b][/h3][p]Super Earth High Command has completed fleet-wide upgrades to the previously unused terminal opposite the armory. Now Helldivers will be able to get more context to the ongoing Campaigns and their subsequent Major Orders. Each Campaign will come with its own potential reward, should the Helldivers be victorious in a majority of the Major Orders within it. The terminal will also feature an archive (to be populated as the first campaign concludes) so that new and returning Helldivers can read up on the twists and turns of previous campaigns.  [/p][h1]
⚖️ [b]Balancing[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]General balance changes[/b][/h3][h3][b]Vehicle armor and enemies AP rebalance
[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Super Earth vehicles now have more accurate Armor values (Bastion gets heavy armor, exosuits a mix of heavy and medium armor, ballistic shield heavy armor). [/p][/*][*][p]Some enemies have received increased armor penetration values so they can deal with the vehicles, but not all. There will be a lot of smaller enemies and explosions that won't be able to hurt something like the Bastion or the Exo Suits (scavengers, Automatons small arms fire, hunters, small to medium obstacle explosions, cyborg small arms etc).[/p][/*][*][p]But there are still a lot in the enemies arsenal that can hurt you (and also important is that a lot of YOUR arsenal now has a harder time hurting your own vehicles). [/p][/*][*][p]Some enemies have had their durable damage reduced[/p][/*][*][p]There  are too many changes to properly list, so we ask you to play and tell us how it feels. The intent is the following[/p][list][*][p]The Bastion tank should feel “tankier” and ignore small attacks, withstand more medium attacks and its survivability against heavy attacks should be unchanged[/p][/*][*][p]The Exo Suits have a similar change as the Bastion tank in terms of ignoring more small attacks and withstanding medium attacks better. The increase in health should overall make it feel a bit more tanky even against heavy attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]The FRV has received an increase in health that will make it handle medium attacks similar to before, but be able to withstand heavy attacks better granting better survivability.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ballistic Shield should feel like it can ignore small attacks and handle medium attacks better.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Sentry health rebalance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased the health of all sentries by 100% to compensate for the general damage increase of enemies vs vehicles.[/p][list][*][p]We have previously increased durable damage on a lot of enemies and since sentries are durable they have lost some of their utility. We didn't want them to become squishier, this change should improve their versatility on the battlefield.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Reloading improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improvements to make reloading more responsive, part of this is allowing reloading while dodge diving, also remembering the reload state better so if you're ragdolled while reloading you will continue it when regaining control.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced the concept of delayed reloads. If you try to trigger a reload while the player is not allowed to do so, the reload will be delayed until the player is able to reload with a maximum of 1.2s delay from when the reload input was pressed. 
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bastion Pattern Customization
[/b][/h3][list][*][p]If you own the vehicle patterns from a Premium Warbond, they can now also be applied to the Bastion Tank! It does not apply to Legendary Warbonds retroactively at this time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Decreased Exo Suit cooldown
[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reduce the cooldown of mechs from 10 minutes down to 8. The intent is to find a better balance with mechs and allow more time with fun stratagems[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Throwables amounts rebalance[/b][/h3][p] [/p][list][*][p]Intent is to make some of the less used throwables more available and viable options[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Orbitals damage rebalance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Intent is to make the larger orbitals feel more like the large projectiles from orbit as they are so the projectile and explosion damage should better match that.[/p][/*][*][p]Larger projectiles explosions like the 380mm and 120mm are increased to make close hits more effective vs larger enemies like Chargers.[/p][/*][*][p]Compared to explosions like the Ultimatum these will have less damage at the center, but also less damage fall off so it will have a more consistent damage over its total area.[/p][/*][*][p]The Railcannon also got more damage to be more effective vs some of the largest enemies like the Vox engines. newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
Helldivers 2 still has every right to be considered among the best co-op games, but there's been discontent in the ranks of Super Earth lately. Head over to Steam and you'll find a 'mixed' recent review rating, with a growing desire for more regular updates and new methods of persistent progression. Developer Arrowhead Game Studios has answered the call. In a new message to the community, Game Director Mikael Ariksson walks through incoming upgrades to both community-wide and personal progression, along with the exciting promise of full ship customization.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Helldivers 2 is adding new war campaigns and full ship customization, to offer "more valuable upgrades for every kind of player"

newsitems.title: Transmission from the Game Director: Progressing Progression
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p][i]Greetings Helldivers,[/i][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]This week we're passing the keyboard to our game director, Mikael Eriksson, to chat about the near future of progression in Helldivers 2. Spoiler alert - changes to both Community and Personal progression are inbound![/i] 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/6e49348dc57bd1dc676984de8dddaf3c3ffa3de0.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Hello,[/p][p][/p][p]Today there's a lot to talk about, but let's start by talking about progression, and why it's not progressing [i]faster[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]The way we see it, there's two broad categories of progression in our game: [b]Community Progression[/b], which is the community journey and contribution to the Galactic War, and [b]Player Progression[/b], which is your personal journey, and contribution and impact on the war development. Both are very important to us and I want to share some of the development work taking place on these systems.[/p][p][/p][p]We have consistently received feedback around our endgame progression plans, with players asking about level cap increases and additional ship modules. Simply put: we feel like previously seen progression elements, like raising the level cap in silo, aren’t enough and wouldn't address your feedback on a foundational level. We are going to raise the level cap, but ideally, when we deepen the progression, we want there to be more valuable upgrades for every kind of player–not just our players who have unlocked 100% of all the offerings.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's start with [b]Community Progression[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Some of the most epic moments in this game have been when the community worked together to achieve common goals ("send more dudes!"). Everything from earning cool rewards to shaping the lore of the universe like unlocking the Exosuit, saving the children, or holding the line against the Illuminates on Calypso. However, we want to do more to improve how players interact with the Galactic War, collaborate as a community, and receive rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]For example, it's never been clear if the actions of the community actually lead to different outcomes, or if it's all just smoke and mirrors.The reality is that the community impact on the Galactic War differs, but even in the cases where we did a lot of work to prepare for very different outcomes, we've struggled to communicate it in the game  [/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, unless you joined right at the start of a big event like the Battle for Super Earth or the Cyberstan Invasion, it's been difficult to understand what's going on. Even if that can be funny sometimes, ("[i]... all I know is that I must kill![/i]"), it was never intended to be confusing for players. [/p][p][/p][p]For those and other reasons, we are launching [b]Galactic War Campaigns[/b] in June. In a nutshell, Campaigns are the next evolution of Major Orders. They will be roughly 1-3 weeks in length with the intention that it will always be clear what the active Campaign is, how it's going, what the outcomes have been, and what's at stake.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/a1aeb341f09a0de4354c470ef171bd9024f55d09.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In more exciting news: the other thing we heard is that players like to EARN more rewards, so the introduction of Campaigns means there will always be at least one Campaign reward if the conditions are met. We want to make these rewards special, because we also think players should earn more than just medals. We’ll experiment with different rewards, ranging from gameplay altering effects to cool items, and alongside you, we'll keep playing with this over the coming months and see what you think. It also means there is more stuff for players to work towards outside of warbonds. Pray J.O.E.L is feeling generous, the first reward you’ll be working to unlock is a new FRV![/p][p][/p][p]Looking a bit further into the future, I want to talk about [b]Planet Warfronts[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Before we launched the game, we experimented with dynamic warfronts on planets, where players needed to make strategic community decisions on a planet level in order to liberate it. While it was promising, we realized we didn't have the content needed to do it justice at the time. We feel we've now added enough content to realize the vision we had for Planet Warfronts, and it's going to be the next big thing we're working towards in the Galactic War. When you've seen Johan talk about experimenting with roguelite systems, he was referring to this.[/p][p] [/p][p]When we introduce Planet Warfronts, missions will be grouped under different categories: [/p][list][*][p]"Defend" missions in liberated territory[/p][/*][*][p]"Frontline War" missions on the frontlines [/p][/*][*][p]"Behind Enemy Lines" missions in enemy controlled territory[/p][/*][/list][p]Players will fight to reach key strategic locations on planets, like cities, which can have different active enemy variants in different areas of the planet. Of course, you’ll [i]still [/i]have the Game Masters to contend with, too. In the final version of this feature, there will also be gameplay altering effects and consequences for achieving planet liberation goals, like reaching and liberating a city within X time or disabling enemy artillery in one location to unlock crucial Operations. The intention is to make it more fun to liberate planets with your squad and deepen the Galactic War and Community Progression systems. We want liberating planets to feel unique and epic for everyone. We have some development and design work ahead to make these feel great and provide the best experience, but I wanted to share just one of the ideas we have in active development. More to come on these changes in the next few months![/p][p][/p][p]Alright, but what about [i][b]Player[/b][/i][b] Progression[/b]?[/p][p][/p][p]As Game Director, it's important to me to make sure our players' personal motivations to play Helldivers 2 aren't in conflict with the goals of both their immediate squad or the community as a whole. For example, if you had a goal to kill 100 Bile Titans, and your squad didn't, you might be inclined to go, "[i]Sorry guys, I've got medals to earn. Leeeerooooy![/i]" I feel that Personal Orders have run into this issue many times, so we are transforming that system into "Personal Campaign Progression." The intent is for every Galactic War Campaign to come with a personal progression reward track. That way, even if the community fails to reach a larger goal, players can still do their part toward their personal goals and get rewarded with cool things to mark their participation in various Campaigns. This change won't happen with the launch of Galactic War Campaigns, but we are planning to deploy it this year.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, let's talk about ships! We’re bringing two big changes to your Super Destroyers: we are extending gameplay progression [i]and[/i] adding customization to make every ship unique.[/p][p][/p][p]Upgrading your ship will be the most exciting for players early on in their Helldivers 2 journey, but we also have some plans for the long term. An area that isn't really living up to its potential is the ship module system: right now, players have the same progression path, with very little agency or ability to adapt to different playstyles. And even if you've unlocked all the ship modules, your ships don't really look that different or feel personalized in any way.[/p][p][/p][p]For that reason and more, we're working on an overhaul of the ship module system that will change how this works, by adding more player agency and significantly increasing the offerings for players to progress. Not only that, we're also adding more ships! The biggest shift we've done internally is we now have a dedicated ship team, working on the first new ship. Our intention is that each new ship will have their own unique progression paths, specializations and customizations. And if you like the ships, we want to keep adding them; at least the ones we've planned so far![/p][p][/p][p]I can't share when the new ship can reach your hands... [i]yet[/i], but I'll be sharing more details later this year for certain. [/p][p][/p][p]One last thing I [i]can[/i] share is a list of some upcoming fixes that we also hope will improve your experience in Helldivers 2. [/p][p][/p][p]You can expect to see these changes very soon:[/p][list][*][p]Helldivers will be able to use assisted reload, as long as either the carrier [i]or[/i] the reloader of the weapon have the corresponding backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]More emotes! Helldivers will have 8 emote slots instead of 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Reducing dead input on stimming.
[/p][/*][/list][p]And coming a bit further down the line, we’re tackling[/p][list][*][p]Stratagem bouncing. We've assembled a task force to prototype fixes for this issue and we're hoping to have it solved by the end of the year.[/p][/*][*][p]Hellpod steering. Similar to stratagem bouncing, we're also tackling this long standing issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Improving enemy and player traversal, which includes environmental collision and reducing movement penalties on grass and vegetation.[/p][/*][*][p]Increasing the level cap to 300[/p][/*][*][p]Economy and resource improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to the Warbond and Superstore menus that make them easier to navigate.[/p][/*][*][p]Closed beta testing that focuses on stability and balancing, and that includes getting beta test feedback from our Propaganda Commanders.
[/p][/*][/list][p]While this is not an exhaustive list of everything we're planning, I hope it gives you some insight into what's coming up next for Progression, and some of the reasoning behind the path we've chosen. I can't wait to hear and read what you think, and to get this into your hands.[i] [/i][/p][p][/p][p]See you on the battlefield, [/p][p]Mikael
[i]Game Director[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: Optimizing Liberty - Incoming Patch: 27th May
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]Greetings Helldivers,[/p][p]In our last blog, we talked about improving how we communicate with you, and that commitment continues here! We’re focused on being clearer, more consistent, and giving you better visibility into what’s coming and why.[/p][p]We’re excited to announce a new set of technical improvements, deploying May 27th. In collaboration with our partners at Nixxes, this release brings a range of long-awaited updates across all platforms.[/p][p]Every frame counts when the pressure is on. This update focuses on three primary pillars: stability, latency reduction, and advanced upscaling technologies - helping ensure performance stays consistent, even in the most demanding moments.
[/p][h2][b]Upscaling Support
[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/65e12c20f446d7ce62bed8e5e6703c253e29a60e.png"][/img][i]We heard you.
[/i][/p][p]To ensure maximum visual clarity without sacrificing performance, we have integrated the latest upscaling solutions tailored to your specific hardware.[/p][list][*][p][b]PC[/b][/p][list][*][p]FSR (High-End): 4.0.3 (on supported GPUs)[/p][/*][*][p]FSR 3.1.5, DLSS 4.5, and XeSS 3.0 support.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PS5 Pro:[/b] PSSR 1[/p][/*][*][p][b]PS5:[/b] FSR 3.1[/p][/*][*][p][b]Xbox:[/b] FSR 3.1[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Advanced Visual Optimizations[/b][/h3][p]Beyond resolution, we are introducing several features to smooth out your gameplay experience and optimize GPU workload.[/p][list][*][p][b]Variable Refresh Rate (VRR):[/b] Now supported for PS5 and PS5 Pro to reduce any potential stuttering from V-Sync without screen tearing on supported displays. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Variable Rate Shading (VRS):[/b] This technology intelligently reduces shading rates in certain areas of the image, decreasing GPU load while maintaining visual quality where it matters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Resolution Scaling (DRS):[/b] Integrated for both PS5, Xbox Series X and PC to maintain stable frame rates during more graphically demanding scenarios.[/p][list][*][p]Increased resolution to 1440p in the “Performance” preset on PS5 and Xbox Series X, as well as the “Quality” preset on PS5 Power Saving Mode. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Reduced Latency for Split-Second Reactions[/b][/h3][p]Responsiveness is critical during tense battles, and we’ve worked with hardware partners to reduce input latency.[/p][list][*][p][b]NVIDIA Reflex:[/b] Now available for users with NVIDIA GPUs to sharpen responsiveness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AMD Anti-Lag 2:[/b] Fully supported for AMD GPU users to ensure your inputs are registered instantly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This update, along with additional fixes, will drop on [b]May 27, 2026[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]But we’re not stopping there, Helldivers. This is just the opening salvo in an ongoing campaign to improve performance across the fleet. Following this release, we’ll be closely monitoring all platforms and hardware configurations, keeping a sharp eye out for anything that needs tuning, and deploying further adjustments as required. We’re also preparing a dedicated tech-focused update later this summer to push these improvements even further.[/p][p][/p][p]With our friends at Nixxes dropping onto the battlefield as our backup, we're committing to make diving with your friends better and better. And keep the feedback coming, Helldivers, it's the key to helping us shape the future of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]See you all on the battlefield.[/p][p]

newsitems.title: Transmission from Super Earth Command
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]To our Dedicated Citizens of Super Earth,[/p][p]We’ve been following your feedback over the past few days and seeing the conversations across the Helldivers 2 community.
[/p][p]Helldivers 2 matters to all of us, and we want to be clearer about what we’re working on and what’s coming next.[/p][p]
Alongside new content, we’re focused on improving the core of the game - stability, progression, and the Galactic War.[/p][p]
Below, we’ve pulled together answers to some of the questions we’re seeing across Reddit, Discord, and X. We’ll keep sharing more as we go.
[/p][p][b]What is the team focusing on right now? What are their current priorities?[/b][/p][p]Right now, a major focus for the team is improving meta-progression and the Galactic War.[/p][p]We’ve significantly expanded the team working in this area, reflecting how important these long-term systems are for the overall player experience.
[/p][p]The goal is to deliver deeper progression and a more engaging Galactic War, with features like:[/p][list][*][p]More meaningful rewards and community progression systems[/p][/*][*][p]Evolving Major Orders into longer, multi-week themed “Campaigns”[/p][/*][*][p]Branching outcomes that create clearer stakes and consequences based on player actions
[/p][/*][/list][p]You’ll start to see the first results of this work this summer. [/p][p][/p][p][b]In multiple updates there have been hidden changes to weapons or enemies. Why were they not announced in patch notes? [/b][/p][p]We want our patch notes to be as clear and complete as possible, to the level of detail that matters to our players.
[/p][p]In some cases, changes have not been communicated with the clarity we intend, and we are continuing to improve our internal process so patch notes more accurately reflect gameplay adjustments.[/p][p]
We are also working on how we explain balance updates more clearly, especially when a change can have effects across multiple weapons, enemies, and gameplay systems.
[/p][p][b]Will we get more frequent updates about the game?[/b][/p][p]Yes — improving how regularly and clearly we communicate is a priority for us.[/p][p]
We’re moving toward more consistent communication updates, with deeper conversations happening more often.[/p][p]
In the near term, the conversations will be focusing on the biggest issues we’re seeing from players, including:[/p][list][*][p]Tech and performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]The vision for game balance moving forward[/p][/*][*][p]Player progression and the broader player experience within the Galactic War
[/p][/*][/list][p]Alongside this, we’ll be more transparent about community feedback - including what we’re seeing, what we’re prioritising, and what actions we’re taking. You’ll start to see this reflected more clearly in patch notes and other updates.
[/p][p][b]What quality of life upgrades and changes will we see for the Galactic War? Maybe variation in reward types, like when we used to get stratagems as rewards. Will we do more community-driven events with rewards like that?[/b][/p][p]Good news — updates to the Galactic War and its rewards are coming this summer.[/p][p]We’ve seen the feedback around rewards, and we want them to feel more distinctive, more meaningful, and more worthy of the battles you’re fighting.
[/p][p]This includes adding greater variety to rewards and bringing back more of the excitement players have called out - including things like stratagem unlocks and more community-driven moments.
[/p][p]We also want the Galactic War itself to feel more reactive to player actions, with events and outcomes that carry more weight.[/p][p]
We will be sharing more details soon on how this connects to progression, balance, and the overall experience.
[/p][p][b]Will you ever have public beta testing? What is your beta testing process like now?[/b][/p][p]Yes - expanding how we test updates with players is a priority for us.
[/p][p]We’re exploring having more closed and public beta testing, with the goal of getting broader feedback, especially for balance changes, before they go live.[/p][p]
One of the challenges is finding the right balance between testing changes openly and not spoiling upcoming content or narrative elements tied to the Galactic War.[/p][p]
Today, we run closed playtests that cover both new content and balance changes, as well as wider internal studio playtests. Going forward, we’re looking at ways to separate these out so we can test balance more openly where it makes sense.[/p][p]
Overall, our goal is to expand the footprint of our testing programs and bring more of the community into that process over time.
[/p][p][b]Why did you put exosuits in the Exo Experts warbond? Does this mean we won’t get an exosuit for free ever again?[/b][/p][p]The goal with the Exo Experts Warbond was to create something that felt thematically strong and exciting, with exosuits as a core part of that fantasy.
[/p][p]That said, we’ve seen the feedback around how that landed - especially when it comes to expectations around how players unlock major gameplay items like exosuits.[/p][p]
More broadly, we want to strike the right balance between what’s included in Warbonds and what’s available through gameplay, so that rewards feel both exciting and fair.[/p][p]
And to be clear - [b]yes[/b], you will be getting other vehicles through gameplay in the future.
[/p][p][b]When will we get new red stratagems and ship modules?[/b][/p][p]We’ve got teams actively working on both new red stratagems, evolving ships, and player progression to level 150… and beyond!
[/p][p]Our goal is to expand these areas in ways that add meaningful new options and support different playstyles, rather than just adding more for the sake of it.[/p][p]
We’ll be sharing more details as these get closer to release.
[/p][p]Salutes to all our divers,
[/p][p]Arrowhead[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.contents:
[p]I'm your host, Release Captain Morris. When humanity is at stake, we bring you this update from Super Earth High Command to further your efforts in the war.
[/p][p]*** INCOMING MESSAGE FROM SUPER EARTH HIGH COMMAND ***[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/4f20b18d16facb875670a7852501fa5568c3d7d0.jpg"][/img]The beauty of our most Democratic galaxy is truly unparalleled. As we push into new territories, we have discovered planets with lush, tranquil forests with winding paths and shade from massive trees.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Underneath the peaceful tree canopies, our Citizens can take time to unwind and reflect on the glory of Managed Democracy and the good, achieved by Super Earth's most illustrious heroes.[/p][p]
[/p][p]However, not everything on these planets is what it seems. We have detected several of our Un-Democratic foes on the perimeter and there have also been some alarming signals on Gloom-infested planets--larger than the typical Terminid convoys, bearing a striking resemblance to some of the Bile Titan signals detected in other regions.[/p][p]
It is time to arm yourself with the new Exo Experts Warbond* equipped with new exosuit designs well-suited for close combat and fire-based offense. Originally deployed to clear land for a six‑star holiday resort, these suits have since been repurposed to leave enemies with nowhere left to hide.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Stay alert, Helldivers–these forests have eyes. [/p][p]

newsitems.title: The Exo Experts Warbond lumbers onto the battlefield
newsitems.author: Miitchimus
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/c7c46d97f7de786f07b99fc8241b982a234fcfe4.jpg"][/img]Machines… Our enemies… But they can also be forces for good, tools at our disposal, and when you need to fight fire with fire it is important to be an [b]Exo Expert.[/b] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/917d0faa2fbb91d81869bed5c347d65eaa9ac3ee.jpg"][/img]
The Ministry of Defense has authorised the immediate mobilisation of new Exosuits to aid in our ongoing war efforts against the enemies of Managed Democracy. 
[b][u]Weapons and Stratagems[/u][/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/23711a028a3b68ba36eaab244351415e3d3be8d2.jpg"][/img][b][u]

[/u][/b]Let’s start where all good Warbonds start, with the latest offensive items included in the Exo Experts*. Beginning with[b] EXO-51 Lumberer[/b], a modern reinvention of the Lumberers of the first Galactic War, this Exosuit is equipped with an anti-tank cannon and a flamethrower allowing you to unleash maximum devastation upon your foes and then purge smaller enemies in the flames of Liberty.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/24e65c2c969a02239d8cc29010646d7d677736e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Next up, we have the [b]EXO-55 Breakthrough[/b]. Brandishing a flak cannon and a ballistics shield, allowing you to face off with Super Earth's toughest foes whilst laying down heavy fire.[/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/25f4872de75236ab72131b9a9556b8f8c290f78f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For those who don’t like to overburden themselves, we are introducing the[b] MGX-42 Bullet Storm[/b]: a disposable machine gun sporting caseless ammunition in multiple barrels. Each usage includes 2 of these so you can throw them away when you are done. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/f26dd02b816c85237fa6f65c34923f4327936da1.jpg"][/img]
Not forgetting our ground troops! We have the [b]SMG-203 Gallant[/b], a submachine gun with a high rate of fire, this is the MP-98 Knight’s older brother, sacrificing clip size for increased penetration. Finally to round out your kit, try the new [b]P-20 Missile Pistol [/b]utilising the latest in guided, heat-propelled rounds and a lock-on feature. Proven to hit its target 60% of the time, every time.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/702d1a219250d86a15e049c92b7e339ca1b71da1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/088a8398ee4284107826e1d4c20128b7f9b53dc4.jpg"][/img]
[b][u]Armors and capes[/u][/b][/p][p]

To ensure you remain compliant with safety regulations, make sure you have these new armors. The [b]O-2 Heavy Operator [/b]armor is the state mandated uniform for Super Earth Citizens who must operate heavy machinery and is best paired with the [b]Watchful Compatriot [/b]cape, which sports a retro print that was first made popular in GW1 cereal merchandising. It helps citizens to remember that not all machines are twisted mechano-socialists; some are piloted by true-hearted humans and we can all rest easy in their gaze.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/def311428283842e367dfae68440029656eec0b9.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]The [b]O-3 Free Spirit [/b]armor[b] [/b]comes equipped with SteerComfort, this armor that allows the wearer to feel every curve, bump, and jostle of their Exosuit, as if they were drifting into one single being.The [b]Free Spirited Spangles [/b]cape pays tribute to the mischief-makers and mavericks, those trailblazers who dutifully execute their orders with universally-endearing panache. The star-crossed trail calls to mind the special kind of Freedom that can only be achieved by going very fast in very expensive state-owned vehicles.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/fc2c56442e3ce75f2707d6d912cf226dacf19346.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
These new armors come stock standard with the [b]Oxygenator[/b] perk allowing you to walk, run and slide slightly quicker (within Super Earth Health and Safety guidelines). 

To ensure others know you are up to the job, you can also equip the new[b] Exosuit Certified [/b]title and make sure to let them know how you feel with the [b]Thumb of Approval[/b] emote and victory pose
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/16d0521d49ddf0f26c01d688cf09c9df2a31a1b9.jpg"][/img]This Warbond also includes the [b]Mobile White[/b] patterns.

[i]So prepare to become an Exo Expert on April 28th
*Warbond requires base game, Super Credits, and game progression to unlock.
[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/094b99c44bb47fa1b886c784d4b330aeac7cce17.png"][/img][/p]

Update: Arrowhead have just shared a graphic outlining what's coming in the next couple of months of Helldivers 2 updates. April's Terminid-themed update 6.2 will deliver two new biomes, fresh galactic war campaigns, and a new enemy variant. May's update 6.3, meanwhile, will come with a single new biome and its own fresh galactic war twists. Both months'll also boast the usual warbond and bug fixing patches.

newsitems.title: Machinery of Oppression: 6.1.0
newsitems.author: Elemdil
newsitems.contents:
[p]Release Captain Morris here with a small update this fine Tuesday![/p][p][/p][p]The Galactic War never rests, and neither can you. While you lick the wounds caused by the Automatons on Cyberstan, Super Earth’s other numerous enemies seek opportunities to rob us of our Democracy. It’s time to rally.[/p][p][/p][p]On [b]Friday, March 20[/b], 2186, we are mobilizing our divers based on new intelligence gathered by High Command.[/p][p]This time, the Illuminate have put new pieces on the board. Illuminate Appropriators have made themselves known–shielded, powerful, and arriving in Illuminate Fleets, as well as hordes of Fleshmobs and Voteless.[/p][p]But that’s not all. New planetary conditions have been detected, and the squids have commanded nature itself to work against us in the form of the Illuminate Exostorms with intense wind and lightning strikes. You will have to destroy their Exospires to calm the storm.[/p][p][/p][p]We have already authorized the launch of new tools to help you: the Entrenched Division Premium Warbond should aid in tackling this new mission: flame, gas, or the safe haven of a freshly-dug trench are the new tactics.
[/p][p]As you weather the storms of Illuminate space, never forget: the squids are no match for Managed Democracy.
[/p][p][b]Please note: The PC large build has now been removed. In order to access this update and future updates, please switch to the default (previously [i]slim[/i]) build.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Patch Highlights[/b][/h3][p][/p][p align="center"][b][i]*** This content will unlock on Friday, March 20. ***

newsitems.title: Hunker down with the Entrenched Division!
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]Keep your head down and keep your feet dry, Helldiver, because this is definitely going to get messy. The Ministry of Defense has authorized the deployment of a new Premium Warbond perfect for frontline assault squads who aren’t afraid to get their hands dirty.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/eda0cf461497bd75fd7cea7eafba44cd113cb8c9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Weapons & Stratagems[/b][/p][p]Let’s dig into the latest offensive items included in Entrenched Division*![/p][p][/p][p]You’ll be bucking all those pesky, modern conventions with the B/FLAM-80 Cremator in hand. This heavy support flamethrower sprays a continuous column of flame, thanks to its massive backpack fuel tank.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/5ff5a518247282b9b061e42cb57e2d71fc708488.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/47bfbc73c5c8a972503e5578295982ecc5bc4af8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In case that’s not enough to fan the flames for you, try the SMG/FLAM-34 Stoker. This versatile submachine gun primary packs two punches at once: iron sights and an incineration attachment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/fb2f67373e9623496bd1f70a5da9d2b7c342cd44.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/5c04ab3bedb4f984bce53b1236a9be670f9f13cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you don’t want to use fire to clear the tunnels, consider using gas! The A/GM-17 Gas Mortar Sentry is an automated turret that fires gas shells–just make sure to stay upwind of those clouds, Helldiver![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/c1170e0d2f3c3264b8e466ad9973bc022d98028e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The P-69 Veto is a stylish secondary pistol, loaded with jet-assisted rounds that let you keep your distance from encroaching hostiles–perfect for the discerning squad commander.[/p][p][/p][p]And if you need to lob a grenade out of the trench, we recommend the G-48 Giga Grenade throwable, which might be too heavy to throw great distances, but it makes up for range with a massive blast that will break up the oncoming enemy into much smaller, more manageable pieces.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/73b136d8dab09a1f665192ac5e090b6051ffc604.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And most thrillingly of all: the CQC-73 Entrenchment Tool is now available for your regular loadout as a secondary weapon! No more rifling through deceased colonist’s belongings to find a shovel–you’ll be digging ditches as soon as your hellpod lands![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/3202746ce59b7bc0cf52283a4e5feb9c66f2bd72.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Armors & Capes[/b][/p][p]Stay sheltered from artillery in vintage style with two brand new armors!  
[/p][p]You might want to bring some extra supplies as you shovel your way to the front line. The CPG-48 Sapper is a medium armor with plenty of pouches and big pockets to store your battlefield essentials. In fact, it comes with a version of the Concussive Padding armor passive–Grenadier–which provides explosive damage resistance and lets you store extra throwables! To complete your entrenched look, use this armor with the Dignity of Toil cape and player card to honor your most useful everyday carry tool: your shovel.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/1d5ceb8a81eb749d994f6e93b05cf9ac57146e17.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But let’s say you need to look more official to motivate the squad stuck in the battle trenches. For that, you’ll want the CPH-26 Commandant light armor with–as pristine as your service record, with a high collar to match your high ambition to move up through the ranks. It’s the kind of fit that says [i]I could court-martial you at any time[/i], and pairs perfectly with the Crest of the Unsullied cape and player card. It also has its own version of the Concussive Padding passive–Hazmat–which provides both explosive and gas damage resistance, as well as reduced sidearm recoil.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/2f08fc94397a29d3aeef9a39f1129e052efe00f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Patterns, emotes, and more[/b][/p][p]Of course, you don’t want to use antiquated equipment, but maybe you’d still like to give your items an old luster just for fun. Give your loadout the lived-in, battle-worn look of a real soldier with the Heritage Olive pattern, available for your hellpods, FRV, Pelican, and exosuits.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/e0aa7114aa880b05d9bc6ab503f97c836c952360.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And if we’re playing as old-fashioned soldiers, why not greet each other the old-fashioned way with a Diplomatic Handshake! You might be gassing and burning your enemies, but you keep the squad dynamics [i]classy[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/0a6dda019f8abaa5d98fd42ba1046cb978a85bd8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Finally, equip the Mudskipper player title to really delve deep into the fantasy of an entrenched soldier on the frontlines. 
[/p][p]The Entrenched Division Premium Warbond is dropping on March 17! Can you dig it, Helldiver?
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/e91adf8009433a5b9a33ab4f7942ca0185c45e17.jpg"][/img][i]*Requires base game, paid purchase of Super Credits, and game progression to unlock.[/i][/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Hard drive space for all! Helldivers 2's slimmer install size is rolling out to everyone later this month
newsitems.contents:
There is no greater source of tepid rage than when I see a game, I buy it, I proceed to download it, and it tells me it needs to take up one billion gigabytes of my hard drive space (NB: one billion is an exaggeration). It fills every corner of my being with a potent darkness, and I would like it to stop. This is a feeling many had with Helldivers and its ludicrously large 154GB install size, leading to a test build of the game to be released by Arrowhead last year knocking it way down to only 23GB in size. And now, after some testing, this build will be available to everyone!

newsitems.title: The Cyborg Threat Reveals itself in Machinery of Oppression
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]In an unprecedented and unforeseeable event, the Cyborgs have returned to once again threaten the liberty and sovereignty of Super Earth and its inhabitants. This nightmarish turn of events follows the discovery that the Automatons seized the schematics for the Star of Peace with the intent to build one for themselves and use it for their dark and violent purpose. They have been tasked by the Cyborg Legion to carry out these crimes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/9e457050bde2be4d5ac908a830b498bf537a20f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Helldivers have been ordered to take on the dark and grim streets of Cyberstan’s cities and stop this collusion of bots and Cyborgs in its tracks![/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Factory Cities[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/758fc1c4b715b281c075bd1c09677c382e330f3a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now Super Earth is taking the fight to the heart of Cyberstan. Drop into the bot homeworld and prepare to breach the fortress walls of their massive factory cities. Fight through the inhospitable landscapes that power the Automaton war machine: industrial complexes that are heavily defended with hazards around every corner. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/9ac3832f6f8d2e036f0a2b68061bcd6b51b55c8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The community of Helldivers must [b]work together[/b] to clear a path through Cyberstan’s factory cities–choose which cities to destroy, making sure to bring down every building and leave no bot standing as you democratize these heartless machines.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Mission & Objectives[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/0757561558c8387439c8d48ab9033ec97d376618.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Your primary mission will be to stop the production of more Cyborgs, as well as compromise Automaton defenses trying to stand in your way. Helldivers will also have the opportunity to clean up: destroy their mega factories building by building, and tear down the symbolic statues of the war criminals and terrorists revered by Cyborg scum in order to further destabilize and demoralize their regime.[/p][p][/p][p]But beware–an old familiar threat rises in these dark, foreboding streets: the Cyborgs have returned with new weapons of mass destruction.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Old Enemies Return[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/1045caacc71a6e1afd0a6346dcc93bdd564bcd23.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You must face down three new types of enemies in the Cyborg subfaction. Outsmart the [b]Agitators[/b], who command the Automaton legion in the field, are heavily armored and can take control of enemy squads, making tactical decisions on the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/e9afbd8705f90222da8d0e7ee9a2c41291eec1ce.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight them while the Cyborg [b]Radicals[/b] rush you from every side to make the fight up close and personal. They are the most extreme vision of a wretched Cyborg-run future: they push their bodies to the limit with cybernetic and bio-enhancements, turning themselves into a mockery of humanity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/75369e1089317c27288901ce75abd5b739fd1acd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And finally, fight the [b]Vox Engine[/b]: the Voice of the Cyborg Legion. This war machine, piloted by a high-ranking Cyborg officer, rolls across the battlefield, blaring Cyborg’s propaganda. It is armed with dual laser cannons, rockets, laser gatlings–all to ensure no one can stop the spread of their message.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Helldivers Call for Aid[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/35710636b9040dab68b448cfc7814bc97043372d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And Super Earth shall answer! Along with the recently-deployed Siege Breakers Warbond* which features defensive assistance like the G/SH-39 Shield, Helldivers will also be able to purchase the War Horses set of armor in the Superstore.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Global Reinforcement Limits[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/1f836dfdb0273baf8d9f86445c4010c3492b6cc4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Sending reinforcements to Cyberstan is a great risk for Super Earth, which means it will be essential for the Helldivers to stay alive for as long as possible. 

Every death will be counted in the Battle for Cyberstan, using a [b]Galactic Reinforcement Counter[/b] marking the finite number of Helldivers able to be deployed. If the counter reaches zero, it means we have lost the Battle for Cyberstan.

Helldivers, we [i]cannot[/i] lose to this renewed Cyborg threat. Your objectives must be completed while ensuring maximal lifespans for all divers. Stim your squadmates, bring defensive stratagems, and survive as you fight your way across Cyberstan, destroying the factory cities together![/p][p]
The latest [i]Helldivers 2[/i] update, [i]Machinery of Oppression[/i], is live now![/p]

[/p][h2]⚖️ [b]Balancing
[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]General changes overview[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p]Melee weapons and Armor passive with increased melee damage re-balance[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Intent is to make the Armor passive that increases melee damage less mandatory but still be useful to make melee weapons more effective.[/p][/*][*][p]We increased all the melee weapons damage and decreased the modifiers on the armor passives that increase melee damage.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Total damage with the melee armor passive will be higher or the same as before.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Base melee attack also got a 50% damage increase.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]SMG and Pistol rounds less Sway[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The intent is that the increased drag of SMG and Pistol which make it a close combat weapon and less effective at range is the main characteristic of these weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]We decreased the Sway modifier to be the same as most other weapons[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Unify Weapon function directions inputs[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The intent is to make the "weapon function modes" that are similar to be on the same "weapon function direction input".[/p][/*][*][p]This is to make it easier to remember which direction similar types of weapon functions are and also make it so you need to use less "quick weapon functions" inputs.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon function modes that affect Programmable ammo, Ammo types, Volley modes, Safe modes, Guided modes will now be in the left direction. [/p][/*][*][p]We have not moved the underbarrel weapon switching option to the left yet, but we are looking into moving it to the left direction so all ammo altering switching is in the left direction even if it is an underbarrel selection that usually is in the down direction.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Difficulty on difficulty 9+[/p][p]
Made changes across all factions to increase the intensity on high difficulties, the biggest change should be noticed on the Automaton front while Terminids and the Illuminate are less affected.[/p][p]

[/p][p][b]Hang Detection[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As part of our ongoing war against bugs and instability we have introduced a “hang detection” feature in the PC version. newsitems.title: Helldivers break down the barricades with Siege Breakers!
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]Helldivers, do you ever find the squad standing before a towering foe with impenetrable fortifications and wish you had something to smash through them? The Ministry of Defense has just the Warbond for you. Let’s get to smashing, divers![/p][previewyoutube="u9E9-iGwK_4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/3dc63103446408a39498141f8f6d8e224019ff73.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Weapons & Stratagems[/b][/h3][p]So what are the tools that will break down the door to the enemy compound? Let’s start with the new and improved version of a beloved[i] Helldivers[/i] weapon: the LAS-16 Trident! This big, bold, and shotgun-like updated classic fires six beams compared to the original’s three! Nothing’s gonna stand in the LAS-16 Trident’s way.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/61d227414200b5da1f2374c0ec9bddff7ab0fcb9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But if you need to make a statement when you break down the bulwark, you might want to bring the CQC-20 Breaching Hammer stratagem. This sledgehammer can do straight smashing, or it can have an explosive charge attached to its head to drive the point home.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/bded4dc15501093894abc7f1b5eea49285ff6fc4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let’s say you get tired from all the hammer-swinging, though, and you need a way to simplify your destruction. Why not use the GL-28 Belt-Fed Grenade Launcher that lets you continuously fire grenades in a non-stop, explosive barrage?[/p][p]And if you’re only interested in sending a single, strong message, we’ve also included the EAT-411 Leveller that fires one high-yield missile.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/16f814e0ce40309c74f9d6986012f2cc4eaf8a2d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Finally, the perfect companion to an offensive loadout like this one is a good defense. The G/SH-39 Shield is a throwable emplacement that generates a spherical, projectile-blocking shield. Make your own barrier while you bust down all the others.
[/p][h3][b]Armor & Capes[/b][/h3][p]As for the rest of your defense, we have the heavy SA-8 Ram armor, evoking heavy plate armor and blast shields, to turn you into a blockade-battering force. Similarly, the medium armor, SA-7 Headfirst, still looks well-defended, but allows for the flexibility and speed you might need to get past the roadblock.
[/p][p]These armors are outfitted with the Supplementary Adrenaline passive, which allows the wearer to regain some stamina whenever they take damage, turning you into the tireless battering ram at the enemy’s wall.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/6c5bf1b1b55f013d4a634f59ce44420ebb8fda5c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These armors have coordinating capes and player cards, starting with the Rags of the Fashionable, which comes pre-tattered to signal your participation in previous enemy sieges. There’s also the Wedgeful Tricorn, which has a saw-tooth shape along the bottom edge. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/83864fb81c792c62888ccea3c2253581d77bf435.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Emotes, patterns, and more[/b][/h3][p]To coordinate your squad, we have also included a pattern for your shuttle, exosuits, hellpods, and FRV called Churned Earth. Siege Breakers also includes the Display of Brawn emote, for both regular and victory poses! And when you show it off, why not equip the Bunker Buster player title, too, to look like the formidable opponent you are.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/23404d82151ee6e484287d3734e1cc8191750dd8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hold your ground just a bit longer, Helldivers. The walls will crumble at your feet on [b]February 3[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][i]*Requires base game, paid purchase of Super Credits, and game progression to unlock.[/i][/p]

newsitems.contents:

newsitems.title: The Redacted Regiment sneaks its way into Helldivers 2
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[p]The Ministry of Defense Research & Development teams have emerged from their laboratories with the latest suppression technology and spec ops fashions to bring the Helldivers a new set of gear to live out their dream of furtive expeditions on fringes of the galaxy. The Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond* will be available for acquisition on January 20th! [/p][previewyoutube="AtvwvsJRSKk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/fb4c8d8606481bf10d8168a9bff03abee03add4b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Weapons & Stratagems[/b][/p][p]Redacted Regiment will outfit you with two primary weapons. The R-72 Censor is a mid-range precision rifle with an integrated suppressor that will ensure you’re undetectable on the battlefield. But if you need to put a few more bullets down range, you can opt for the AR-59 Suppressor, which is a fully automatic assault rifle with a non-removable suppressor.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/971ab0b1c8c6d32abb5f9bddb9350ed0be8744db.png"][/img][/p][p]To complete your loadout for covert reconnaissance, you can equip the P-35 Re-Educator dart-firing secondary pistol. Each round releases a chemical agent that induces delirium in organic targets and delirium-like malfunction in inorganic ones.[/p][p][/p][p]If stealth isn’t your tactic, you can try to go the commando route with the B/MD C4 Pack stratagem. This backpack has six adhesive C4 charges and a wireless detonator set up for either individual or simultaneous detonation–that should let you be as strategic or destructive as you like while pushing the button from a minimum safe distance.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/5122687e50aa8e8822f22846d9277af8b0d27342.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But you might want to wage a little more unconventional warfare by diverting the enemy away from you. In that case, you’ll want the TM-01 Lure Mine, which is a throwable anti-personnel mine that will stick to surfaces and emit lights and sounds to attract nearby targets and then detonate when they’re in close proximity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Armors, Capes, and More[/b][/p][p]Redacted Regiment comes with two armors and two capes perfect for recon roleplay. You can get the look of a real operative with the RS-89 Shadow Paragon light armor–covered in multitudinous pads and pouches to hold all your tactical EDC items–or fly under the radar with the RS–67 Null Cipher medium armor that’s coated in a radar-absorbent polymer and null-signature heat baffle to turn you into a real sensor ghost. Both armors are fitted with the Reduced Signature passive, which reduces your noise level and the range at which the enemy can detect you. The enemies of Democracy will have to get real close before they can spot you.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/f241617bc43884af557d399d35255972d2d0488d.png"][/img][/p][p]These pair perfectly with the Pillar of the Abyss and Triangulation Veil capes and player cards. You’ll also receive a new victory pose, Target Sighted, to let your squad know you’ve got your eye on the enemy.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/44f6b9f071e3e33ad8ae57a02816224a242cd61f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The new booster, Concealed Insertion, will equip your Hellpod with a smokescreen to deploy on impact, so your dive can be on the down low.
[/p][p]You’ll also be able to claim a new player title, \[Redacted]. Maybe you can’t share the details of your assignment, but you can let them know you’ve seen some real action.[/p][p][/p][p]Redacted Regiment is coming January 20th, Helldivers. Get ready to infiltrate and perform a surgical strike–they’ll never see you coming.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/1be847530e9657ecadf446793431290e8c501116.jpg"][/img][/p][p]*[i]Requires base game, paid purchase of Super Credits, and game progression to unlock.[/i][/p]

The Helldivers 2 Killzone crossover last year was meant to be just that - weapons and armor sets that celebrate Guerrilla Game's shooter series while fitting into the galactic battles of Arrowhead's excellent co-op game. Arm yourself with some of the best weapons Stål has to offer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/eb6280417a78ea9baef120295b9c6edf9fb31a4f.png"][/img]Beginning with the[b] StA-52 Assault[/b] [b]rifle[/b] the pride of the Stål armory, providing you with the strength to decimate your foes. It boasts a high-capacity drum mag, great for providing sustained fire. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]StA-11 SMG[/b] with a helical-feed magazine, which provides a higher ammo capacity whilst making it more front heavy. This close-range weapon is the nightmare of the enemies of freedom.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/cf5162141ed2601bea6190b7b7866f74ac033f05.png"][/img][/p][p][b]PLAS-39 Accelerator rifle[/b], a high precision burst-fire rifle that will banish your foes after a short charging period. [/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]Armors and capes:[/b][/u] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/fcecc0f0193d83f1a09f88040735317d6aa58aba.png"][/img][/p][p][b]AC-1 Dutiful/ The Strength in Our Arms cape[/b] 
This heavy armor boasts a breathing apparatus built in to help both soldiers and colonists thrive, even when assigned to planets with atmospheres rated "suboptimal", "extreme", and "character building". 
 
[b]AC-2 Obedient/ Defender of Our Dream cape[/b] [/p][p]The muted colors and relaxed, high mobility fit make this light armor a favorite among long-distance snipers and hide-and-seek champions alike. 
 [/p][p][b]Acclimated passive[/b] 
The passive of these armors provides 50% resistance to fire, gas, acid, and electrical damage. 
 [/p][p]The “[b]Defender of Our Dream[/b]” and “[b]Strength in Our Arms[/b]” player cards are also returning along with the [b]Assault infantry[/b] player title 
 
[u][b]New Patterns:[/b][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/73502147bacb5f5637f0667a8cd2fdc4352ada47.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The latest additions to round out this Warbond are the [b]Extrasolar Ash patterns [/b]for your Exosuits, FRV, Hellpods and Pelicans.  [/p][p] [/p][p]So start saving your Super Credits for December 18th at 3pm CET when [b]Helldivers™ 2 x Killzone[/b] [b]Legendary Warbond [/b]will be available for purchase from wherever you enjoy our game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/e365931b8de60e43fcdd6d5733846c9fac26eb3a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]*[i]Requires base game, paid purchase of Super Credits, and game progression to unlock.[/i] [/p][p][i]**Regional limitations apply.[/i][/p][p][i]Please note you will not be able to claim the Helldivers™ 2 x Killzone Legendary Warbond with a Premium Warbond token.[/i] [/p]

newsitems.title: HELLDIVERS 2 Tech Blog #2
newsitems.author: The Baskinator
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Introduction[/h1][p]Hey Helldivers,[/p][p]This blog post is a follow up to my previous post about the installation size of the game on PC which you can find [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/553850/view/543369627969783286?l=english"]here[/url]. 
[/p][p]Today, I will update you on our progress in reducing the installation size and how you can help.
 [/p][h1]PC Installation Size[/h1][p][b]Update[/b][/p][p]We have followed through on our plans and made small reductions in the PC installation size over the last few patches while still adding new content. While this was a good start, our short term fixes have not been enough to keep up with all of the new content in the latest patch. The longer term goal has always been to bring the PC installation size much closer in line with the console versions. We are happy to report that, thanks to our partners at Nixxes, we have reached that goal much sooner than expected. By completely de-duplicating our data, we were able to reduce the PC installation size from ~154GB to [b]~23GB[/b], for a total saving of [b]~131GB (~85%).[/b] We have completed several rounds of internal QA and are ready to roll this out to early adopters as a public technical beta. Our testing shows that for the small percentage of players still using mechanical hard disk drives, mission loading times have only increased by a few seconds in the worst cases. This is live NOW![/p][p][/p][p][b]Only a few seconds difference?[/b][/p][p]Further good news: the change in the file size will result in minimal changes to load times - seconds at most. “Wait a minute,” I hear you ask - “didn’t you just tell us all that you duplicate data because the loading times on HDDs could be 10 times worse?”. I am pleased to say that our worst case projections did not come to pass. These loading time projections were based on industry data - comparing the loading times between SSD and HDD users where data duplication was and was not used. In the worst cases, a 5x difference was reported between instances that used duplication and those that did not. We were being very conservative and doubled that projection again to account for unknown unknowns.[/p][p][/p][p]Now things are different. We have real measurements specific to our game instead of industry data. We now know that the true number of players actively playing HD2 on a mechanical HDD was around 11% during the last week (seems our estimates were not so bad after all). We now know that, contrary to most games, the majority of the loading time in HELLDIVERS 2 is due to level-generation rather than asset loading. This level generation happens in parallel with loading assets from the disk and so is the main determining factor of the loading time. We now know that this is true even for users with mechanical HDDs. 
[/p][p][b]Great! When does this happen? How can I help?[/b][/p][p]Do you want to be an early adopter? You can opt-in right now and help us test the slim version! There are no functional differences between the legacy and slim versions besides the installation size. You will be connected to the same galactic war as everyone else and be using the same account you always do - so all progression, war contributions and purchases will carry over between the different versions. You will still be able to matchmake and play with all other players. You can also opt-out at any time if you experience issues. It’s a low-risk way to save ~131GB of space on your drive and help us extend our testing to real-life conditions. Full instructions for opting in and out of the technical beta can be found at the end of this blog post.
[/p][p][b]The future![/b][/p][p]When the public technical beta confirms that there are no issues present in the slim version, it will become the default version for everyone. For a limited time, we will allow players to opt-in to the legacy version as a way to self-troubleshoot any issues that were not picked up during our internal testing or the public technical beta. Given the very minor differences in loading times between the two versions, there is no justification for us to keep supporting the legacy version long term. Maintaining the legacy version alongside the slim version would only add extra burden to our developers, build machines, QA teams and release processes. Assuming all goes smoothly, the legacy version will be discontinued some time next year. 
[/p][p][b]Finally[/b][/p][p]Thank you to the community for all your support with the game as we work through these technical pieces, and thank you to our partners at Nixxes for helping us troubleshoot and implement all the above improvements.[/p][p] [/p][h1]Beta Instructions[/h1][h2]Warning![/h2][p][i]Modders beware![/i] Any patch we roll out can break the game if you have mods installed and this one is no exception. We recommend that only players with a clean installation opt-in to the slim version. As always, [i]you mod the game at your own risk[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]If any of this seems a bit scary to you, we encourage you to just sit back and wait for the slim version to become the default version.[/p][p][/p][h2]Opting in to the slim version[/h2][p][b]Step 1.[/b][/p][p]In your steam library, right click on HELLDIVERS 2 and select ‘Properties’.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/a5af134f0b1aba606a6372bb65b6b919c0dfcb28.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Step 2.[/b][/p][p]Next select the ‘Betas’ tab.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/36df9abfb7bd53e82981bbc99b1679fcbf9a8fa2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Step 3.[/b][/p][p]In the Beta Participation drop down list, select “prod_slim”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156989/26ce05e92bb9ad8f65f165acbc9119406d32aae7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Step 4.[/b][/p][p]Finally just close the properties dialog and wait for the game to download the patch![/p][p][/p][h2]Opting out of the slim version[/h2][p]If for any reason you want to opt-out of the slim version, you can repeat the above steps and select “None” from the Beta Participation drop-down instead. If you opt-out due to experiencing problems with the slim version, please report them to our [url="https://arrowhead.zendesk.com/"]player support team[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Opting in to the legacy version[/h2][p]In case of emergency! Once we make the slim version the default version, you will be able to opt-in to the legacy version by selecting “prod_legacy” from the Beta Participation down-down. This will only work for a limited time, so please be sure to report any issues specific to the slim version to our [url="https://arrowhead.zendesk.com/"]player support team[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]
